questions.question: On the 1st day of a school camp, there were 396 children. 27 boys left the camp on the 2nd day. If there were 2 times as many boys as girls who remained at the camp, how many boys were there on the 1st day of the camp?
questions.hint: 1st find how many children remained. Split that total into 2 equal units for boys and 1 equal unit for girls, then restore the boys who left.
questions.questionZh: 在学校营地的第1天，有396名儿童。第2天，有27名男孩离开了营地。若留在营地的男孩人数是女孩人数的2倍，那么营地第1天有多少名男孩？
questions.hintZh: 第1步，求还剩多少名儿童。把该总数分成男孩的2个相等单位和女孩的1个相等单位，再把离开的男孩人数加回去。

en.strategy: Find how many children remained after the boys left, use the 2:1 boys-to-girls ratio, then add the departing boys back.

steps.title: Find the children remaining
steps.text: 396 − 27 = 369 children remained at the camp.

steps.title: Use the 2:1 ratio
steps.text: The 369 remaining children made 2 + 1 = 3 equal parts. 369 ÷ 3 = 123, so the remaining boys numbered 2 × 123 = 246.

steps.title: Restore the boys who left
steps.text: Add back the 27 boys who left: 246 + 27 = 273.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求离开男孩后剩下的儿童人数，按男孩和女孩的2:1人数比分配，再把离开的男孩加回去。

questions.question: On Monday, Farmer Tom collected 3 times as many eggs as Farmer Jack. On Tuesday, Farmer Tom sold 160 eggs. Farmer Jack then had 2 times as many eggs as Farmer Tom. How many eggs did Farmer Jack have?
questions.hint: Draw Tom as 3 units and Jack as 1 unit before the sale. After the sale, Jack is 2 units more than Tom; use the 160-egg difference.
questions.questionZh: 周一，Tom农夫收集的鸡蛋数是Jack农夫的3倍。周二，Tom农夫卖出了160个鸡蛋。此后，Jack农夫拥有的鸡蛋数是Tom农夫的2倍。Jack农夫有多少个鸡蛋？
questions.hintZh: 卖出前，将Tom表示为3个单位，将Jack表示为1个单位。卖出后，Jack比Tom多2个单位；利用160个鸡蛋的差额求解。

en.strategy: Represent Farmer Jack's eggs by one amount and Farmer Tom's original eggs by three times that amount.

steps.title: Set up the quantities
steps.text: Let Farmer Jack have x eggs. Farmer Tom collected 3x eggs on Monday.

steps.title: Use the condition after the sale
steps.text: After selling 160 eggs, Tom had 3x − 160 eggs. Jack then had 2 times Tom's amount, so x = 2(3x − 160).

zh-Hans.strategy: 把杰克农夫的鸡蛋数设为1个量，汤姆农夫原有的鸡蛋数就是这个量的3倍。

steps.title: 设出两人的鸡蛋数
steps.text: 设杰克农夫有x个鸡蛋，那么汤姆农夫周一收集了3x个鸡蛋。

steps.title: 利用卖出鸡蛋后的关系
steps.text: 汤姆卖出160个后有3x − 160个。此时杰克的鸡蛋数是汤姆的2倍，所以x = 2(3x − 160)。

questions.question: When George is 15 years old, his sister is 8 years old and his father is 45 years old. How old will George's sister be when George is 1/2 his father's age?
questions.hint: The father is always 30 years older than George. Find George's age when he is 1/2 his father's age, then add the same number of years to his sister's age.
questions.questionZh: 当George 15岁时，他的妹妹8岁，父亲45岁。当George的年龄是父亲年龄的1/2时，他的妹妹将几岁？
questions.hintZh: 父亲始终比George大30岁。求出George的年龄等于父亲年龄的1/2时他几岁，再在妹妹的年龄上加上相同的年数。

en.strategy: Use the constant age difference between George and his father, then add the elapsed years to his sister's age.

steps.title: Find the father-son age difference
steps.text: When George is 15 and his father is 45, the difference is 45 − 15 = 30 years.

steps.title: Find George's required age
steps.text: When George is half his father's age, let George be g. His father is g + 30, so g = 1/2(g + 30). Thus 2g = g + 30 and g = 30.

steps.title: Advance the sister's age
steps.text: George grows from 15 to 30, an increase of 15 years. His sister will be 8 + 15 = 23.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用乔治和父亲之间不变的年龄差，求乔治达到条件时的年龄，再给妹妹增加相同的年数。

steps.title: 求父子年龄差
steps.text: 乔治15岁、父亲45岁，年龄差为45 − 15 = 30岁。

steps.title: 求乔治满足条件时的年龄
steps.text: 设乔治为g岁，父亲为g + 30岁。题意给出g = 1/2(g + 30)，所以2g = g + 30，g = 30。

steps.title: 计算妹妹的年龄
steps.text: 乔治从15岁到30岁经过15年，妹妹的年龄是8 + 15 = 23岁。

questions.question: Linda and Serene had an equal number of balloons. After Linda used 16 balloons, Serene had 3 times as many balloons as Linda. How many balloons did Serene have?
questions.hint: After Linda uses balloons, Serene's unchanged amount is 3 equal units while Linda has 1. The 2-unit difference is 16.
questions.questionZh: Linda和Serene原有同样多的气球。Linda用了16个气球后，Serene的气球数是Linda的3倍。Serene有多少个气球？
questions.hintZh: Linda用掉气球后，Serene未变的数量是3个相等单位，而Linda是1个单位。2个单位的差额是16。

en.strategy: Let the equal original number of balloons be one variable and compare Serene's unchanged amount with Linda's amount after using 16 balloons.

steps.title: Represent the original equal amounts
steps.text: Let each girl originally have b balloons. Serene still has b, while Linda has b − 16.

steps.title: Use the three-times condition
steps.text: Serene has 3 times Linda's remaining balloons, so b = 3(b − 16).

zh-Hans.strategy: 把两人原来相同的气球数设为一个未知量，比较瑟琳娜不变的数量和琳达用掉16个后的数量。

steps.title: 表示原来的相同数量
steps.text: 设两人原来各有b个气球。瑟琳娜仍有b个，琳达有b − 16个。

steps.title: 利用3倍关系
steps.text: 瑟琳娜的气球数是琳达剩余数量的3倍，所以b = 3(b − 16)。

questions.question: Jennifer had a party. She wanted to give an equal number of balloons to her 6 friends. If 1 of her friends did not turn up for the party, the rest would be able to receive another 2 balloons each. How many balloons did Jennifer have?
questions.hint: With 1 friend absent, 5 friends each receive 2 more balloons. That extra distribution accounts for 10 balloons; use it to find each original share.
questions.questionZh: Jennifer举办了一场派对。她想把气球平均分给她的6位朋友。如果其中1位朋友没有来参加派对，其余的人每人就能多得到2个气球。Jennifer有多少个气球？
questions.hintZh: 有1位朋友缺席时，5位朋友每人多分到2个气球。这部分额外分配的气球共计10个；利用它求出最初每人应得的数量。

en.strategy: Compare the total balloons when 6 friends attend with the total when only 5 friends attend and each gets 2 more.

steps.title: Represent the original share
steps.text: Let each of the 6 friends receive x balloons when all attend. Jennifer then has 6x balloons.

steps.title: Use the absent-friend situation
steps.text: With 1 friend absent, 5 friends each receive x + 2 balloons, so the same total is 5(x + 2).

steps.title: Solve for the total
steps.text: 6x = 5(x + 2), so x = 10. Therefore Jennifer had 6 × 10 = 60 balloons.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较6位朋友都到场时的气球总数和只有5位朋友到场、每人多得2个时的气球总数。

steps.title: 设原来的每人份数
steps.text: 设6位朋友都到场时每人分得x个气球，珍妮弗共有6x个气球。

steps.title: 利用1位朋友缺席的情况
steps.text: 1位朋友没来时，5位朋友每人分得x + 2个，所以总数是5(x + 2)。

questions.question: Anna had 3 times as many beads as Zoe. They had 480 beads altogether. Mrs Taylor gave an equal number of beads to each of them. Zoe then had 1/2 the number of beads that Anna had. How many beads did Mrs Taylor give them?
questions.hint: At 1st, Anna and Zoe are 3 units and 1 unit. Equal additions do not change their difference; after the gifts, Anna is 2 units more than Zoe.
questions.questionZh: Anna的珠子数是Zoe的3倍。她们一共有480颗珠子。Taylor太太给她们每人同样多的珠子。此后，Zoe的珠子数是Anna的1/2。Taylor太太给了她们每人多少颗珠子？
questions.hintZh: 第1步，Anna和Zoe分别为3个单位和1个单位。增加相同数量不会改变她们的差额；收到珠子后，Anna比Zoe多2个单位。

en.strategy: First find Anna's and Zoe's original bead counts from the 3:1 ratio, then use the final one-half relationship after equal gifts.

steps.title: Find the original bead counts
steps.text: Anna : Zoe = 3 : 1, or 4 parts altogether. 480 ÷ 4 = 120, so Anna had 360 beads and Zoe had 120 beads.

steps.title: Represent the equal gifts
steps.text: Let Mrs Taylor give each girl t beads. The new counts are 360 + t and 120 + t.

steps.title: Apply the final half relationship
steps.text: Zoe then has 1/2 of Anna's amount: 120 + t = 1/2(360 + t). Thus 240 + 2t = 360 + t, so t = 120. She gave 2 × 120 = 240 beads altogether.

steps.title: 设每人得到的珠子数
steps.text: 设泰勒太太给每人t颗珠子，得到后的数量分别为360 + t和120 + t。

questions.question: Helen had to arrange some chairs in a fixed number of rows. She estimated that there were more than 30 but fewer than 70 chairs. If she put 8 chairs in 1 row, she would be 7 chairs short. If she put 7 chairs in 1 row, she would have 2 chairs left. How many chairs were there?
questions.hint: Look for a number between 31 and 69 that is 2 more than a multiple of 7 and 7 less than a multiple of 8.
questions.questionZh: Helen要把一些椅子排成固定行数。她估计椅子超过30把但少于70把。如果每1行放8把椅子，她就会差7把；如果每1行放7把椅子，就会剩2把。共有多少把椅子？
questions.hintZh: 寻找31到69之间的一个数：它比7的倍数多2，并且比8的倍数少7。

en.strategy: Find a number from 31 to 69 that leaves 2 when arranged in rows of 7 and becomes exactly divisible by 8 after adding the 7 chairs she lacks.

steps.title: Translate the 7-chair row condition
steps.text: Having 2 chairs left in rows of 7 means the total has the form 7n + 2.

steps.title: List possible totals in the range
steps.text: Between 31 and 69, the possible totals are 37, 44, 51, 58, and 65.

steps.title: Test the 8-chair row condition
steps.text: She is 7 chairs short for rows of 8, so total + 7 must be divisible by 8. Only 65 + 7 = 72 = 9 × 8.

zh-Hans.strategy: 在31到69之间寻找一个数：按每排7把椅子排列时余2把，加上缺少的7把后又能被8整除。

steps.title: 表示每排7把时的条件
steps.text: 每排7把椅子后余2把，说明总数可写成7n + 2。

steps.title: 检验每排8把时的条件
steps.text: 还差7把才够按每排8把排列，所以总数 + 7必须能被8整除。只有65 + 7 = 72 = 9 × 8。

questions.question: Zack and Mandy shared 120 sweets. After Zack gave Mandy 10 sweets, he had 2 times as many sweets as Mandy. How many sweets did each of them have at 1st?
questions.hint: After the transfer, Zack and Mandy are in a 2:1 ratio. Use the total of 120 to find their after-transfer amounts, then reverse the 10-sweet transfer.
questions.questionZh: Zack和Mandy分120颗糖果。Zack给Mandy 10颗糖果后，他的糖果数是Mandy的2倍。他们一开始（第1次分配前）各有多少颗糖果？
questions.hintZh: 转移后，Zack和Mandy的糖果数之比为2:1。利用总数120求出转移后各自的数量，再还原这次10颗糖果的转移。

en.strategy: Use the 2:1 ratio after Zack gives Mandy 10 sweets, then reverse that transfer to get the initial amounts.

steps.title: Find the amounts after the transfer
steps.text: After the transfer, Zack : Mandy = 2 : 1 and their total is still 120. One part is 120 ÷ 3 = 40, so Zack has 80 and Mandy has 40.

steps.title: Reverse Zack's transfer
steps.text: Before giving 10 sweets, Zack had 80 + 10 = 90 sweets and Mandy had 40 − 10 = 30 sweets.

steps.title: Check the total
steps.text: 90 + 30 = 120, so the initial amounts use all 120 sweets.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用扎克给曼迪10颗糖后形成的2:1比求当时的数量，再倒推转移前的数量。

steps.title: 求转移后的数量
steps.text: 转移后扎克 : 曼迪 = 2 : 1，总数仍为120。每1份是120 ÷ 3 = 40，所以扎克有80颗，曼迪有40颗。

steps.title: 倒推转移前的数量
steps.text: 转移前扎克有80 + 10 = 90颗糖，曼迪有40 − 10 = 30颗糖。

steps.title: 核对总数
steps.text: 90 + 30 = 120，正好是原来的糖果总数。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：曼迪30颗糖；扎克90颗糖。

questions.question: A basket contained 4 times as many blue balls as red balls. After 21 blue balls were taken away, there were 2 times as many red balls as blue balls. How many balls were there in the basket at 1st?
questions.hint: Draw the blue balls as 8 units and the red balls as 2 units, so that after the removal the new blue amount is exactly 1 unit. The 21 balls taken away are then 7 units.
questions.questionZh: 一个篮子里蓝球的数量是红球的4倍。取走21个蓝球后，红球数量是蓝球数量的2倍。篮子最初（第1次取走前）共有多少个球？
questions.hintZh: 把蓝球表示为8份，红球表示为2份，使取走后新的蓝球数正好是1份。取走的21个球就是7份。

en.strategy: Represent the original red-ball count by one amount and use the fact that, after 21 blue balls are removed, red balls are twice the remaining blue balls.

steps.title: Represent the original balls
steps.text: Let the original number of red balls be r. Then the original number of blue balls is 4r.

steps.title: Use the condition after removal
steps.text: After 21 blue balls are removed, 4r − 21 blue balls remain. There are then 2 times as many red balls as blue balls, so r = 2(4r − 21).

steps.title: Find the original total
steps.text: r = 8r − 42, so 7r = 42 and r = 6. The blue balls were 4 × 6 = 24, giving 6 + 24 = 30 balls.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把原来红球的数量设为一个未知量，再利用拿走21个蓝球后红球数量是剩余蓝球数量的2倍。

steps.title: 表示原来的球数
steps.text: 设原来有r个红球，那么原来有4r个蓝球。

steps.title: 利用拿走后的关系
steps.text: 拿走21个蓝球后，剩下4r − 21个蓝球。此时红球数是蓝球数的2倍，所以r = 2(4r − 21)。

questions.question: Nancy had 1/3 as much money as Ben. Lucy had $20 more than Ben. They had $132 altogether. How much did each of them have?
questions.hint: Let Nancy be 1 unit and Ben be 3 units. Remove Lucy's extra $20 from the total before dividing the remaining 7 units.
questions.questionZh: Nancy的钱是Ben的1/3。Lucy的钱比Ben多$20。他们一共有$132。每个人各有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 设Nancy为1个单位，Ben为3个单位。先从总数中减去Lucy多出的$20，再把剩余部分按7个单位分配。

en.strategy: Use units for Nancy and Ben, remove Lucy's extra $20, and then divide the remaining total into equal units.

steps.title: Set up the unit ratio
steps.text: Let Nancy have 1 unit. Ben has 3 units because Nancy has 1/3 as much as Ben, and Lucy has 3 units plus $20.

steps.title: Remove Lucy's extra money
steps.text: The three people have 1 + 3 + 3 = 7 units plus $20. Remove the extra $20: $132 − $20 = $112.

steps.title: Find each amount
steps.text: $112 ÷ 7 = $16 per unit. Nancy has $16, Ben has 3 × $16 = $48, and Lucy has $48 + $20 = $68.

questions.question: There were 3 parcels, A, B and C. The mass of Parcel B was 3/4 kg less than the mass of Parcel A. The mass of Parcel C was 2/3 kg more than the mass of Parcel B. If the mass of Parcel A was 4 1/2 kg, what was the mass of Parcel C?
questions.hint: Parcel A is 4 1/2 kg. Subtract 3/4 kg to find Parcel B, then add 2/3 kg to find Parcel C. Change to a common denominator before adding or subtracting.
questions.questionZh: 有3个包裹，A、B和C。包裹B的质量比包裹A少3/4 kg。包裹C的质量比包裹B多2/3 kg。若包裹A的质量是4 1/2 kg，包裹C的质量是多少？
questions.hintZh: 从4 1/2 kg中减去3/4 kg，求出包裹B的质量，再加上2/3 kg。分数相加或相减时，使用公分母。

en.strategy: Subtract the stated fraction from Parcel A to obtain Parcel B, then add the stated fraction to obtain Parcel C.

steps.title: Find Parcel B's mass
steps.text: Parcel A is 4 1/2 kg. Parcel B is 3/4 kg lighter, so B = 4 1/2 − 3/4 = 4 2/4 − 3/4 = 3 3/4 kg.

steps.title: Add to find Parcel C's mass
steps.text: Parcel C is 2/3 kg heavier than B: 3 3/4 + 2/3 = 3 9/12 + 8/12 = 4 5/12 kg.

steps.title: Check the stated differences
steps.text: 4 5/12 − 3 3/4 = 2/3 kg, so Parcel C is the required 2/3 kg heavier than B.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先从A包裹的质量中减去给出的分数求B包裹，再加上给出的分数求C包裹。

steps.title: 核对质量差
steps.text: 4 5/12 − 3 3/4 = 2/3 kg，C包裹确实比B包裹重2/3 kg。

questions.question: Mr Rice spent 1/5 of his salary on food and 2/3 on clothing. 1/2 of the remaining amount was given to his wife and he saved the rest. If he had saved $520, what was Mr Rice's salary?
questions.hint: Express 1/5 and 2/3 in fifteenths. After food and clothing, split the remaining fraction equally between his wife and his savings.
questions.questionZh: Rice先生把工资的1/5花在食物上，把2/3花在衣物上。剩余金额的1/2给了妻子，其余存起来。如果他存了$520，Rice先生的工资是多少？
questions.hintZh: 将1/5和2/3化为以15为分母的分数。扣除食物和衣物的开支后，把剩余的分数在妻子和储蓄之间平均分配。

en.strategy: Find the fraction left after food and clothing, then use the fact that savings are half of that remainder.

steps.title: Find the remaining fraction
steps.text: Food and clothing used 1/5 + 2/3 = 3/15 + 10/15 = 13/15 of the salary. The remaining fraction was 1 − 13/15 = 2/15.

steps.title: Find the savings fraction
steps.text: Mr Rice gave 1/2 of the remaining 2/15 to his wife and saved the other 1/2. His savings were 1/2 × 2/15 = 1/15 of his salary.

steps.title: Calculate the salary
steps.text: If 1/15 is $520, the full salary is 15 × $520 = $7800.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求食物和衣服支出后剩下的薪水分数，再利用储蓄是这部分的一半。

steps.title: 求储蓄所占分数
steps.text: 赖斯先生把剩余2/15的一半给妻子，另一半储蓄。因此储蓄是1/2 × 2/15 = 1/15的薪水。

questions.question: Sam had some marbles. He gave 1/7 of them to his brother. 2/3 of the remaining marbles were given to his cousin. The rest were kept in a box. If 48 marbles were kept in the box, how many more marbles did Sam give to his cousin than to his brother?
questions.hint: After giving 1/7 away, the remaining 6/7 is split into 2/3 for the cousin and 1/3 kept. Work backwards from the 48 kept marbles.
questions.questionZh: Sam有一些弹珠。他把其中的1/7给了弟弟。剩余弹珠的2/3给了表亲，其余放在一个盒子里。如果盒子里有48颗弹珠，Sam给表亲的弹珠比给弟弟的多多少颗？
questions.hintZh: 给出1/7后，剩余的6/7分为给表亲的2/3和保留的1/3。从盒中保留的48颗弹珠倒推。

en.strategy: Work backward from the 48 marbles kept, which are one-third of the marbles remaining after Sam gave one-seventh to his brother.

steps.title: Find the marbles remaining after the first gift
steps.text: After giving 1/7 to his brother, Sam has 6/7 left. The 48 marbles kept are 1/3 of this remainder because 2/3 went to his cousin. Thus the remainder is 48 × 3 = 144.

steps.title: Find the original number and each gift
steps.text: If 6/7 of the original number is 144, the original number is 144 ÷ 6 × 7 = 168. His brother received 1/7 × 168 = 24 marbles.

steps.title: Compare the cousin's and brother's gifts
steps.text: His cousin received 2/3 × 144 = 96 marbles. The difference is 96 − 24 = 72 marbles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 从盒中留下的48颗弹珠倒推；这48颗是山姆送给弟弟后剩余弹珠的1/3。

steps.title: 求送给弟弟后剩下的弹珠数
steps.text: 送给弟弟1/7后，剩下6/7。剩下的弹珠中2/3送给表兄弟，盒中留下1/3，所以送弟弟后剩下48 × 3 = 144颗。

steps.title: 求原有数量和送给弟弟的数量

questions.question: Mrs Anderson bought 60 eggs. She used 2/5 of them to bake cakes. She used some eggs to bake cookies. She had 12 eggs left. How many eggs did she use for baking cookies?
questions.hint: Find 2/5 of 60 for the cakes, then subtract both the cake eggs and the eggs left from 60.
questions.questionZh: Anderson太太买了60个鸡蛋。她用其中的2/5烤蛋糕，又用一些鸡蛋烤饼干。她还剩12个鸡蛋。她烤饼干用了多少个鸡蛋？
questions.hintZh: 先求出60的2/5用于烤蛋糕，再从60中减去烤蛋糕用的鸡蛋和剩下的鸡蛋。

en.strategy: Find the eggs used for cakes first, then subtract the cake eggs and the eggs left from the original 60.

steps.title: Calculate the cake eggs
steps.text: Mrs Anderson used 2/5 of 60 eggs for cakes: 2/5 × 60 = 24 eggs.

steps.title: Account for the eggs left
steps.text: After all baking, 12 eggs were left. The cake eggs, cookie eggs, and leftover eggs total 60.

steps.title: Find the cookie eggs
steps.text: 60 − 24 − 12 = 24 eggs were used for baking cookies.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求做蛋糕用掉的鸡蛋数，再从原来的60个中减去做蛋糕的鸡蛋和剩下的鸡蛋。

steps.title: 计算做蛋糕用的鸡蛋
steps.text: 安德森太太用60个鸡蛋的2/5做蛋糕：2/5 × 60 = 24个。

steps.title: 列出剩余鸡蛋的关系
steps.text: 完成所有烘焙后还剩12个鸡蛋。做蛋糕、做饼干和剩下的鸡蛋共60个。

steps.title: 求做饼干用的鸡蛋
steps.text: 60 − 24 − 12 = 24，所以做饼干用了24个鸡蛋。

questions.question: 2/7 of the members in a country club are men. There are 1050 women below 50 years old. If there are 960 more women than men in the country club, how many women are above 50 years old?
questions.hint: If men are 2/7 of the club, women are 5/7. The difference between women and men is 3 equal units, which is 960.
questions.questionZh: 某乡村俱乐部成员中，2/7是男性。有1050名50岁以下的女性。如果该俱乐部中女性比男性多960人，那么50岁以上的女性有多少人？
questions.hintZh: 如果男性占俱乐部成员的2/7，那么女性占5/7。女性与男性的差是3个相等单位，即960人。

en.strategy: Use the 2/7 men and 5/7 women fractions so that the 960-person difference represents 3 equal parts, then subtract the younger women.

steps.title: Find one equal part
steps.text: Women make up 5/7 and men make up 2/7, so the difference is 5/7 − 2/7 = 3/7. Those 3 parts equal 960, so 1 part is 960 ÷ 3 = 320.

steps.title: Find the total number of women
steps.text: Women make up 5 parts, so there are 5 × 320 = 1600 women in the club.

steps.title: Subtract women below 50
steps.text: 1600 − 1050 = 550 women are above 50 years old.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用男性占2/7、女性占5/7，令960人的差额对应3个相等份，再减去50岁以下的女性人数。

steps.title: 求女性总人数
steps.text: 女性占5份，所以女性总数为5 × 320 = 1600人。

questions.question: Stephanie had a total of 80 pieces of $2 and $10 notes. After spending 2/5 of her $2 notes and 8 pieces of her $10 notes, she had an equal number of $2 and $10 notes left. How much money did Stephanie have at 1st?
questions.hint: The 2 kinds of notes left are equal. Since 8 $10 notes were spent, use the total note count to find each original count before calculating the money.
questions.questionZh: Stephanie共有80张$2和$10钞票。她花掉$2钞票的2/5以及8张$10钞票后，剩下的$2和$10钞票数量相同。Stephanie最初（第1次消费前）有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 剩下的2种纸币数量相同。既然她花掉了8张$10纸币，利用纸币总张数求出每种纸币最初的张数，再计算金额。

en.strategy: Let the original counts of $2 and $10 notes be variables, use the equal counts left after spending, and then calculate the original value.

steps.title: Set up the note counts
steps.text: Let x be the original number of $2 notes and y be the original number of $10 notes. Since there are 80 notes, x + y = 80.

steps.title: Use the equal remaining counts
steps.text: After spending 2/5 of the $2 notes, 3/5x remain. After spending 8 $10 notes, y − 8 remain. These are equal, so 3/5x = y − 8.

steps.title: Solve and calculate the value
steps.text: Substitute y = 80 − x: 3/5x = 72 − x. Thus 8/5x = 72, x = 45 and y = 35. The original money was 45 × $2 + 35 × $10 = $440.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把原有的$2和$10纸币张数设为未知数，利用花掉部分纸币后两种纸币剩余张数相等的条件，再计算原有金额。

steps.title: 设出两种纸币的张数
steps.text: 设原有$2纸币为x张，$10纸币为y张。共有80张，所以x + y = 80。

steps.title: 利用剩余张数相等
steps.text: 花掉$2纸币的2/5后，剩下3/5x张；花掉8张$10纸币后，剩下y − 8张。两者相等，所以3/5x = y − 8。

questions.question: 3/5 of the animals on a farm are ducks and the rest are chickens. 1/5 of the chickens are brown and the rest are white. If there are 24 white chickens, how many more ducks than chickens are there on the farm?
questions.hint: White chickens are 4/5 of all chickens. Find the total chickens 1st, then use the 3:2 ratio of ducks to chickens.
questions.questionZh: 农场里的动物中，3/5是鸭子，其余是鸡。鸡中有1/5是棕色的，其余是白色的。如果有24只白鸡，农场里鸭子比鸡多多少只？
questions.hintZh: 白鸡占所有鸡的4/5。第1步求鸡的总数，再利用鸭与鸡的3:2比例。

en.strategy: Use the white-chicken fraction to find all chickens, then use the 3:2 ducks-to-chickens ratio to compare their counts.

steps.title: Find the total chickens
steps.text: Of the chickens, 1/5 are brown, so 4/5 are white. If 4/5 is 24 white chickens, all chickens number 24 ÷ 4 × 5 = 30.

steps.title: Find the ducks
steps.text: Ducks are 3/5 of the farm and chickens are the remaining 2/5, so ducks : chickens = 3 : 2. If 2 parts equal 30 chickens, 1 part is 15 and ducks are 3 × 15 = 45.

steps.title: Compare the counts
steps.text: 45 − 30 = 15, so there are 15 more ducks than chickens.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用白鸡占鸡总数的分数求全部鸡的数量，再用鸭和鸡的3:2比比较它们的数量。

steps.title: 求鸡的总数
steps.text: 鸡中有1/5是棕色，所以4/5是白色。4/5对应24只白鸡，因此鸡的总数是24 ÷ 4 × 5 = 30只。

steps.title: 求鸭的数量
steps.text: 鸭占农场动物的3/5，鸡占剩下的2/5，所以鸭 : 鸡 = 3 : 2。2份对应30只鸡，1份是15只，鸭有3 × 15 = 45只。

questions.question: Susan earns $2450 a month. She spends 2/5 of it and saves the rest. Andy earns $800 less than Susan. He spends $180 more than Susan each month and saves the rest. How much more can Susan save than Andy in 1/2 a year?
questions.hint: Find Susan's monthly saving, then subtract Andy's lower income and extra spending to get his monthly saving. Multiply the monthly difference by 6.
questions.questionZh: Susan 每月赚 $2450。她花掉其中的 2/5，剩下的存起来。Andy 每月比 Susan 少赚 $800。他每月比 Susan 多花 $180，其余的钱存起来。在 1/2 年内，Susan 比 Andy 能多存多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 先求 Susan 每月的储蓄额，再从 Andy 较低的收入中扣除额外支出，求出他每月的储蓄额。将每月的差额乘以 6。

en.strategy: Find each person's monthly saving, then compare the savings over 6 months.

steps.title: Find Susan's monthly saving
steps.text: Susan spends 2/5 of $2450: 2/5 × 2450 = $980. She saves $2450 − $980 = $1470 each month.

steps.title: Find Andy's monthly saving
steps.text: Andy earns $2450 − $800 = $1650. He spends $980 + $180 = $1160, so he saves $1650 − $1160 = $490 each month.

steps.title: Compare 6 months of saving
steps.text: Susan saves $1470 − $490 = $980 more each month. Since 1/2 a year is 6 months, $980 × 6 = $5880.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先分别求出两人每月的储蓄，再比较6个月的储蓄差。

questions.question: On Monday, a shopkeeper sold 12 1/2 kg of flour. He sold 5/6 kg more flour on Tuesday than on Monday. On Wednesday, he sold 1 1/3 kg less flour than on Tuesday. He then had 1/3 kg of flour left in his shop. How much flour did he have at 1st?
questions.hint: Calculate Tuesday from Monday, then Wednesday from Tuesday. Add the 3 daily sales and the flour left, using sixths as a common denominator.
questions.questionZh: 星期一，某店主卖出 12 1/2 kg 面粉。星期二卖出的面粉比星期一多 5/6 kg。星期三卖出的面粉比星期二少 1 1/3 kg。之后，他店里还剩 1/3 kg 面粉。他起初（1st）有多少面粉？
questions.hintZh: 先根据星期一求出星期二的销量，再根据星期二求出星期三的销量。用 6 作公分母，将 3 天的销量和剩余的面粉相加。

en.strategy: Express all daily sales in sixths, then add the sales and the flour left.

steps.title: Find Tuesday and Wednesday sales
steps.text: Monday's sale was 12 1/2 = 75/6 kg. Tuesday's sale was 75/6 + 5/6 = 80/6 kg. Wednesday's sale was 80/6 − 1 1/3 = 80/6 − 8/6 = 72/6 kg.

steps.title: Add all flour accounted for
steps.text: The total sold was 75/6 + 80/6 + 72/6 = 227/6 kg. The 1/3 kg left is 2/6 kg, so the starting amount was 227/6 + 2/6 = 229/6 = 38 1/6 kg.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把每天卖出的面粉都化成以6为分母的分数，再加上剩余量。

steps.title: 求星期二和星期三的销量

questions.question: 2/7 of the toy cars in a box are silver. 1/10 of the remainder are yellow and the rest are black. If there are 28 silver toy cars, how many black toy cars are there in the box?
questions.hint: Use the silver cars to find the total. Yellow cars are 1/10 of the 5/7 remainder; subtract silver and yellow from the total.
questions.questionZh: 某个盒子中有 2/7 的玩具汽车是银色的。剩余玩具汽车中的 1/10 是黄色的，其余是黑色的。如果有 28 辆银色玩具汽车，盒子里有多少辆黑色玩具汽车？
questions.hintZh: 利用银色玩具汽车的数量求出总数。黄色玩具汽车是剩余 5/7 中的 1/10；从总数中减去银色和黄色玩具汽车。

en.strategy: Use the silver fraction to find the total, then remove the silver and yellow cars.

steps.title: Find the total number of cars
steps.text: 28 silver cars are 2/7 of the box. Therefore the total is 28 ÷ 2/7 = 28 × 7/2 = 98 cars.

steps.title: Find yellow and black cars
steps.text: After the silver cars, 98 − 28 = 70 cars remain. Yellow cars are 1/10 of 70, or 7. The black cars are 70 − 7 = 63.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用银色车所占的分数求总数，再从剩余车辆中扣除黄色车。

steps.title: 求玩具车总数
steps.text: 28辆银色玩具车占全盒的2/7，所以总数是28 ÷ 2/7 = 28 × 7/2 = 98辆。

steps.title: 求黄色车和黑色车
steps.text: 扣除银色车后，剩下98 − 28 = 70辆。黄色车是70的1/10，即7辆。黑色车有70 − 7 = 63辆。

questions.question: Andrew and Ryan shared some chocolates. Andrew gave away 1/4 of his chocolates. 1/4 of the given chocolates were taken by Ryan. Ryan then had the same number of chocolates as Andrew. If Andrew gave away 12 chocolates, how many chocolates did each of them have at 1st?
questions.hint: The 12 chocolates given away are 1/4 of Andrew's original amount. Ryan receives 1/4 of those 12; use the equal final amounts to work backwards.
questions.questionZh: Andrew 和 Ryan 分了若干巧克力。Andrew 送出了自己巧克力的 1/4。送出的巧克力中有 1/4 被 Ryan 拿走。此后，Ryan 的巧克力数量与 Andrew 相同。如果 Andrew 送出了 12 块巧克力，他们起初（1st）各有多少块巧克力？
questions.hintZh: 送出的 12 块巧克力是 Andrew 原有数量的 1/4。Ryan 得到这 12 块中的 1/4；利用 2 人最后数量相等这个条件倒推。

en.strategy: Work from Andrew's given-away amount, then reverse the equal final amounts.

steps.title: Find Andrew's original and final amounts
steps.text: The 12 chocolates Andrew gave away were 1/4 of his original amount. Thus Andrew originally had 12 × 4 = 48 chocolates, and he had 48 − 12 = 36 after giving them away.

steps.title: Find Ryan's original amount
steps.text: Ryan took 1/4 of the 12 given chocolates, which is 12 ÷ 4 = 3 chocolates. Ryan finished with the same 36 chocolates as Andrew, so he started with 36 − 3 = 33 chocolates.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由安德鲁送出的数量求出他的原有数量，再从两人最后相等的数量倒推。

steps.title: 求安德鲁原有和剩下的巧克力
steps.text: 安德鲁送出的12颗是他原有数量的1/4，所以他原有12 × 4 = 48颗。送出后剩48 − 12 = 36颗。

steps.title: 求瑞安原有的巧克力
steps.text: 瑞安拿走送出巧克力的1/4，即12 ÷ 4 = 3颗。瑞安最后也有36颗，所以开始时有36 − 3 = 33颗。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 安德鲁有48颗巧克力；瑞安有33颗巧克力。

questions.question: Boxes A and B contained 112 pencils. When 1/5 of the pencils in box A were transferred to box B, both boxes contained the same number of pencils. How many more pencils were there in box A than in box B at 1st?
questions.hint: After transferring 1/5 of Box A, both boxes are equal. Draw Box A as 5 units and compare the before-and-after total of 112.
questions.questionZh: 盒子 A 和 B 中共有 112 支铅笔。当盒子 A 中的 1/5 铅笔转移到盒子 B 后，2 个盒子中的铅笔数量相同。起初（1st）盒子 A 比盒子 B 多多少支铅笔？
questions.hintZh: 转移盒子 A 中的 1/5 后，2 个盒子中的数量相等。将盒子 A 画成 5 个单位，并结合转移前后的总数 112 进行比较。

en.strategy: Model box A as 5 equal units because 1/5 of it is transferred.

steps.title: Set up the unit model
steps.text: Let box A initially contain 5 units. Transferring 1/5 of A moves 1 unit, leaving 4 units in A. For the boxes to be equal, box B must initially have 3 units, because 3 + 1 = 4.

steps.title: Find the difference
steps.text: Together the boxes have 5 + 3 = 8 units, equal to 112 pencils. Thus 1 unit is 112 ÷ 8 = 14 pencils. The initial difference is 5 − 3 = 2 units, or 2 × 14 = 28 pencils.

en.answerCheck: Box A had 28 pencils more than box B at 1st.

zh-Hans.strategy: 因为转走盒A的1/5，所以把盒A原有数量看作5个相等单位。

steps.title: 建立单位模型
steps.text: 设盒A开始有5个单位。转走1/5就是转走1个单位，盒A剩4个单位。转走后两盒相等，因此盒B开始应有3个单位，因为3 + 1 = 4。

steps.title: 求原来的差
steps.text: 两盒共5 + 3 = 8个单位，对应112支铅笔，所以1个单位是112 ÷ 8 = 14支。原来的差是5 − 3 = 2个单位，即2 × 14 = 28支。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 开始时盒A比盒B多28支铅笔。

questions.question: Andrea spent 1/5 of her salary on food and 1/10 on transport. She gave the remaining amount to her 3 brothers equally. 1 of her brothers spent all his money on a radio and a watch that cost $86 and $145 respectively. What was Andrea's salary?
questions.hint: 1 brother received $86 + $145. Multiply by 3 for the total remainder, then recognise that this remainder is 7/10 of Andrea's salary.
questions.questionZh: Andrea 将薪水的 1/5 用于食物，1/10 用于交通。她把剩余的钱平均给了她的 3 位兄弟。其中 1 位兄弟把所有钱都花在了 1 台收音机和 1 块手表上，价格分别为 $86 和 $145。Andrea 的薪水是多少？
questions.hintZh: 1 位兄弟得到的钱为 $86 + $145。乘以 3 得到剩余金额的总数，再注意到这笔剩余金额是 Andrea 薪水的 7/10。

en.strategy: Find one brother's share, combine the 3 equal shares, and scale up from the remaining 7/10 of the salary.

steps.title: Find the money received by one brother
steps.text: The radio and watch cost $86 + $145 = $231. Since one brother spent all of his share on them, each brother received $231.

steps.title: Recover Andrea's salary
steps.text: The 3 brothers received $231 × 3 = $693. Andrea kept 1 − 1/5 − 1/10 = 7/10 of her salary for the brothers. Therefore her salary was $693 ÷ 7/10 = $693 × 10/7 = $990.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求1个兄弟所得的钱，再把3份相加，并由薪水的7/10反求总薪水。

steps.title: 求1个兄弟得到的钱
steps.text: 收音机和手表共花$86 + $145 = $231。这个兄弟把所有钱都花在这两样物品上，所以每个兄弟得到$231。

answerVisual.sourceMethod: Printed ten-unit salary bar allocates two food units and one transport unit, leaving seven equal units for three brothers; it first totals one brother's radio and watch. Canonical discrepancy: none.

questions.question: Ann and James had some stickers. After Ann gave James 1/4 of her stickers, James had 2 times as many stickers as Ann. If they had a total of 117 stickers, how many stickers did each of them have in the beginning?
questions.hint: Treat Ann's original amount as 4 equal parts. After 1 part moves to James, the final ratio is 2:1; use the unchanged total of 117.
questions.questionZh: Ann 和 James 有若干贴纸。Ann 给了 James 自己贴纸的 1/4 后，James 的贴纸数量是 Ann 的 2 倍。如果他们共有 117 张贴纸，起初 2 人各有多少张贴纸？
questions.hintZh: 将 Ann 起初的数量视为 4 个相等部分。转移 1 个部分给 James 后，最终比为 2:1；利用不变的总数 117。

en.strategy: Represent Ann's original stickers as 4 units so that the transferred 1/4 is one unit.

steps.title: Build the before-and-after model
steps.text: Let Ann start with 4 units. She gives 1 unit to James and has 3 units left. James then has 2 × 3 = 6 units, so he must have started with 6 − 1 = 5 units.

steps.title: Use the total
steps.text: Initially they had 4 + 5 = 9 units, equal to 117 stickers. One unit is 117 ÷ 9 = 13 stickers. Ann had 4 × 13 = 52 stickers and James had 5 × 13 = 65 stickers.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把安原有的贴纸看作4个单位，这样她给出的1/4正好是1个单位。

steps.title: 建立转移前后的单位关系
steps.text: 设安开始有4个单位。她给詹姆斯1个单位后，自己剩3个单位。詹姆斯这时有安的2倍，即2 × 3 = 6个单位，所以他开始有6 − 1 = 5个单位。

steps.title: 利用总数求每人的数量
steps.text: 开始时共有4 + 5 = 9个单位，对应117张贴纸。1个单位是117 ÷ 9 = 13张。安有4 × 13 = 52张，詹姆斯有5 × 13 = 65张。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 詹姆斯有65张贴纸；安有52张贴纸。

questions.question: Mrs Brown gave 4/7 of her money to her son. He spent 2/5 of the money on a pair of shoes and the rest on 2 books that cost $18 each. How much did Mrs Brown have at 1st?
questions.hint: The books cost $36, which is the 3/5 of the son's money left after shoes. Find the son's amount, then scale from 4/7 to all of Mrs Brown's money.
questions.questionZh: Brown 太太将自己钱的 4/7 给了儿子。儿子将其中的 2/5 用来买 1 双鞋，剩下的钱买了 2 本书，每本书售价 $18。Brown 太太起初（1st）有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 书的总价是 $36，这相当于儿子买鞋后剩下的钱的 3/5。先求儿子得到的钱，再由 4/7 推算 Brown 太太所有的钱。

en.strategy: Use the book cost to find the son's amount, then scale from 4/7 to all of Mrs Brown's money.

steps.title: Find the son's money
steps.text: The 2 books cost 2 × $18 = $36. This is the 3/5 left after the son spent 2/5 on shoes. Therefore the son received $36 ÷ 3/5 = $36 × 5/3 = $60.

steps.title: Find Mrs Brown's original money
steps.text: The $60 given to her son was 4/7 of Mrs Brown's money. Her original amount was $60 ÷ 4/7 = $60 × 7/4 = $105.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用书的价钱求儿子得到的钱，再由4/7反求布朗太太所有的钱。

questions.question: Ray sold 2/3 of the charity tickets that Cindy sold. Cindy sold 3/4 of the charity tickets that Gina sold. Each charity ticket cost $2. The children collected a total of $648. How many charity tickets did Gina sell?
questions.hint: 1st convert $648 to a total number of tickets. Use a common unit bar: Gina, Cindy, and Ray can be represented by 4, 3, and 2 units.
questions.questionZh: Ray 卖出的慈善票数是 Cindy 的 2/3。Cindy 卖出的慈善票数是 Gina 的 3/4。每张慈善票售价 $2。孩子们共筹得 $648。Gina 卖出了多少张慈善票？
questions.hintZh: 第 1 步，先将 $648 换算成慈善票总数。使用共同单位条：Gina、Cindy 和 Ray 可分别表示为 4、3 和 2 个单位。

en.strategy: Convert the money total into tickets and use the ratio Gina:Cindy:Ray = 4:3:2.

steps.title: Find the number of tickets sold
steps.text: Each ticket cost $2, so the children sold $648 ÷ $2 = 324 tickets altogether.

steps.title: Use the ticket ratio
steps.text: Cindy sold 3/4 of Gina's number and Ray sold 2/3 of Cindy's number. Taking Gina as 4 units gives Cindy 3 units and Ray 2 units. Thus 9 units = 324 tickets, so 1 unit = 36 tickets and Gina sold 4 × 36 = 144 tickets.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先把筹得的钱换成票数，再使用吉娜、辛迪和雷的比4:3:2。

steps.title: 求总票数
steps.text: 每张票价$2，所以孩子们共卖出$648 ÷ $2 = 324张票。

steps.title: 利用票数比
steps.text: 辛迪卖出的票是吉娜的3/4，雷卖出的票是辛迪的2/3。把吉娜看作4个单位，辛迪是3个单位，雷是2个单位。9个单位是324张，所以1个单位是36张，吉娜卖出4 × 36 = 144张。

questions.question: There were 3/4 as many sweets in box A as in box B. 1/2 of the sweets in box A and 3/8 of the sweets in box B were removed. There were then 152 sweets left in both boxes altogether. How many sweets were there in each box at 1st?
questions.answer: Box A: 114 sweets; Box B: 152 sweets
questions.hint: Change 3/4 to 6/8 and model Box A and Box B in eighths. Then keep 1/2 of A and 5/8 of B to represent the 152 remaining sweets.
questions.questionZh: 盒子 A 中糖果的数量是盒子 B 中的 3/4。盒子 A 中的 1/2 糖果和盒子 B 中的 3/8 糖果被拿走。之后，2 个盒子中总共剩下 152 颗糖果。最初（1st）2 盒中各有多少颗糖果？
questions.hintZh: 将 3/4 改写为 6/8，并以 1/8 为单位表示盒子 A 和 B。然后保留 A 的 1/2 和 B 的 5/8，以表示剩下的 152 颗糖果。

en.strategy: Use the initial ratio A:B = 3:4 and apply the fractions that remain in each box.

steps.title: Model the remaining sweets
steps.text: Let box A initially have 3 units and box B have 4 units. Half of A remains, giving 1/2 × 3 = 1 1/2 units. Since 3/8 of B is removed, 5/8 remains, giving 5/8 × 4 = 2 1/2 units.

steps.title: Find the original amounts
steps.text: The remaining total is 1 1/2 + 2 1/2 = 4 units, and this equals 152 sweets. Thus 1 unit = 152 ÷ 4 = 38 sweets. Initially A had 3 × 38 = 114 sweets and B had 4 × 38 = 152 sweets.

en.answerCheck: Box A: 114 sweets; Box B: 152 sweets.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用盒A和盒B原有数量的比3:4，再计算每盒剩下的分数。

steps.title: 表示剩下的糖果
steps.text: 设盒A开始有3个单位，盒B开始有4个单位。盒A剩下1/2，所以剩1/2 × 3 = 1 1/2个单位。盒B拿走3/8，剩5/8，所以剩5/8 × 4 = 2 1/2个单位。

steps.title: 求原有糖果数
steps.text: 剩下的总数是1 1/2 + 2 1/2 = 4个单位，对应152颗糖。1个单位是152 ÷ 4 = 38颗。因此盒A原有3 × 38 = 114颗，盒B原有4 × 38 = 152颗。

questions.question: After their shopping trip, Mike spent 3/5 of his money, Evon spent 1/2 of hers and Sue spent $50. They then had the same amount of money left. If the total amount of money left was $54, what was the total amount of money Mike and Sue had at 1st?
questions.hint: The 3 equal amounts left total $54. Express Mike's original money as 5 units and Sue's as her equal leftover plus the $50 she spent.
questions.questionZh: 购物后，Mike 花掉自己钱的 3/5，Evon 花掉她的钱的 1/2，而 Sue 花了 $50。之后，他们剩下的钱同样多。如果剩余钱的总额是 $54，Mike 和 Sue 最初（1st）共有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 剩下的 3 份相等金额总计为 $54。将 Mike 起初的钱表示为 5 个单位；Sue 起初的钱等于她那份相等的余额加上她花掉的 $50。

en.strategy: First find the common amount left, then reconstruct Mike's and Sue's original amounts.

steps.title: Find the amount each person had left
steps.text: Mike, Evon, and Sue had equal amounts left, and together they had $54. Each therefore had $54 ÷ 3 = $18 left.

steps.title: Find Mike's and Sue's starting amounts
steps.text: Mike had 2/5 of his money left, so his original amount was $18 ÷ 2/5 = $45. Sue spent $50 and had $18 left, so she started with $50 + $18 = $68. Their total was $45 + $68 = $113.

en.answerCheck: Mike and Sue had $113 altogether at 1st.

steps.title: 求每人剩下的钱
steps.text: 迈克、伊冯和苏剩下的钱相同，合共$54。因此每人剩$54 ÷ 3 = $18。

steps.title: 求迈克和苏开始时的钱

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 迈克和苏开始时合共有$113。

questions.question: A baker sold 2 times as many buns on Sunday than on Saturday. On Monday, he sold 1/4 of the buns he sold on Sunday. If he sold a total of 1260 buns during the 3 days, how many buns did he sell on Sunday?
questions.hint: Draw Saturday as 2 units, Sunday as 4 units and Monday as 1 unit, so every day is a whole number of units. All 7 units together are 1260.
questions.questionZh: 某面包师星期日卖出的面包数量是星期六的 2 倍。星期一，他卖出的面包数量是星期日的 1/4。如果他在这 3 天共卖出 1260 个面包，星期日卖出了多少个？
questions.hintZh: 把星期六表示为2份，星期日为4份，星期一为1份，这样每天都是完整的份数。7份合起来是1260。

en.strategy: Express Saturday, Sunday, and Monday as multiples of Saturday's sales.

steps.title: Set up the day-to-day amounts
steps.text: Let Saturday's sales be 1 unit. Sunday sales were 2 units, and Monday sales were 1/4 of Sunday, or 1/2 unit.

steps.title: Find Sunday's sales
steps.text: The 3 days total 1 + 2 + 1/2 = 3 1/2 units = 1260 buns. One unit is 1260 ÷ 3 1/2 = 360 buns. Sunday sales were 2 × 360 = 720 buns.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把星期六、星期日和星期一的销量都表示成星期六销量的倍数。

steps.title: 建立每天销量的关系
steps.text: 设星期六卖出1个单位。星期日卖出2个单位，星期一卖出星期日的1/4，即1/2个单位。

answerVisual.sourceMethod: Printed day bars avoid halves by choosing Saturday:Sunday:Monday = 2:4:1. Canonical discrepancy: none.

questions.question: Joan and Alan had some money. 2/3 of Joan's money was 1/2 of what Alan had. If Alan spent all his money on a book that cost $45 and a wallet that cost $98, how much did Joan and Alan have altogether?
questions.hint: Find Alan's money from the book and wallet. If 2/3 of Joan equals 1/2 of Alan, make both amounts use the same 6-part bar.
questions.questionZh: Joan 和 Alan 有些钱。Joan 钱的 2/3 等于 Alan 所有钱的 1/2。如果 Alan 将所有钱都用来买 1 本售价 $45 的书和 1 个售价 $98 的钱包，Joan 和 Alan 总共有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 根据书和钱包的价格求出 Alan 的钱。若 Joan 的 2/3 等于 Alan 的 1/2，就让这 2 个数量都用相同的 6 等分单位条表示。

en.strategy: Find Alan's money from the purchases, then use the equality between 2/3 of Joan's money and 1/2 of Alan's money.

steps.title: Find Alan's amount
steps.text: Alan spent all his money on a $45 book and a $98 wallet, so he had $45 + $98 = $143.

steps.title: Find Joan's amount and the total
steps.text: Half of Alan's money is $143 ÷ 2 = $71.50. This equals 2/3 of Joan's money, so Joan had $71.50 ÷ 2/3 = $107.25. Together they had $143 + $107.25 = $250.25.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由艾伦购买物品的价钱求出他的钱，再用琼的2/3等于艾伦的1/2这个关系求解。

steps.title: 求艾伦的钱数
steps.text: 艾伦把所有钱买了$45的书和$98的钱包，所以他有$45 + $98 = $143。

answerVisual.sourceMethod: Printed aligned money bars set Joan to three units and Alan to four, making Joan's shaded two units equal Alan's shaded two units; Alan's full four units come from his two purchases. Canonical discrepancy: none.

questions.question: Boxes A and B contained 150 marbles altogether. When 1/3 of the marbles in box A were transferred to box B and 12 marbles were taken out from box B, there were 2 times as many marbles in box B than in box A. How many marbles were there in box B in the beginning?
questions.hint: After the 12 marbles are removed, 138 remain and the final boxes are in a 1:2 ratio. Reverse the transfer of 1/3 of Box A to recover Box B's starting amount.
questions.questionZh: 盒子 A 和 B 中共有 150 颗弹珠。当盒子 A 中的 1/3 弹珠转移到盒子 B，且从盒子 B 中取出 12 颗弹珠后，盒子 B 中的弹珠数量是盒子 A 的 2 倍。起初盒子 B 中有多少颗弹珠？
questions.hintZh: 取出 12 颗弹珠后，还剩 138 颗，最后 2 个盒子的数量比为 1:2。逆向还原盒子 A 中的 1/3 转移过程，以求出盒子 B 起初的数量。

en.strategy: Use the final 1:2 ratio after the 12 marbles are removed, then reverse the transfer.

steps.title: Find the final amounts
steps.text: After 12 marbles are taken out, 150 − 12 = 138 marbles remain. The final ratio A:B is 1:2, so box A has 138 ÷ 3 = 46 marbles and box B has 2 × 46 = 92 marbles.

steps.title: Reverse the transfer
steps.text: Box A's final 46 marbles are 2/3 of its original amount, because 1/3 was transferred. Thus A originally had 46 ÷ 2/3 = 69 marbles, so 69 ÷ 3 = 23 were transferred. Box B began with 92 − 23 + 12 = 81 marbles.

en.answerCheck: Box B had 81 marbles in the beginning.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用拿走12颗后的1:2比例求最后数量，再倒推转移前的数量。

steps.title: 求最后两盒的数量
steps.text: 拿走12颗后，剩下150 − 12 = 138颗。最后盒A与盒B的比是1:2，所以盒A有138 ÷ 3 = 46颗，盒B有2 × 46 = 92颗。

steps.title: 倒推转移前的数量
steps.text: 盒A最后的46颗是原有数量的2/3，因为转走了1/3。因此盒A原有46 ÷ 2/3 = 69颗，转走69 ÷ 3 = 23颗。盒B开始有92 − 23 + 12 = 81颗。

questions.question: During a sale, Betty bought a watch at 3/5 of its normal price. She then had $220 left. If she had bought the watch at its normal price, she would be $10 short. What was the normal price of the watch?
questions.hint: The difference between paying 3/5 of the price and the full price is $220 + $10. That difference is 2/5 of the normal price.
questions.questionZh: 促销期间，Betty 以手表正常价格的 3/5 买下了 1 块手表。她随后还剩 $220。如果她以正常价格购买这块手表，她会差 $10。手表的正常价格是多少？
questions.hintZh: 支付价格的 3/5 与支付全价之间的差额为 $220 + $10。这个差额是正常价格的 2/5。

en.strategy: Compare the amount paid in the sale with the normal price; the difference is 2/5 of the normal price.

steps.title: Find the saving between the two prices
steps.text: At the sale, Betty had $220 left. At the normal price, she would be $10 short. Therefore the normal price exceeds the sale price by $220 + $10 = $230.

steps.title: Find the normal price
steps.text: The sale price is 3/5 of the normal price, so the difference is 1 − 3/5 = 2/5 of the normal price. Thus 2/5 of the normal price is $230, and the normal price is $230 ÷ 2/5 = $575.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较促销价和原价；两者的差额是原价的2/5。

steps.title: 求两种价格的差额
steps.text: 按促销价买后，贝蒂还剩$220；按原价买则差$10。因此原价比促销价高$220 + $10 = $230。

steps.title: 求原价
steps.text: 促销价是原价的3/5，所以差额是1 − 3/5 = 2/5的原价。2/5的原价为$230，因此原价是$230 ÷ 2/5 = $575。

questions.question: Mr Smith sold 1/4 of his eggs on Monday and 1/4 of the remainder on Tuesday. The rest were sold on Wednesday. If he sold 144 eggs on Wednesday, how many eggs did he have in the beginning?
questions.hint: After Monday, 3/4 remains. Wednesday is 3/4 of that remainder, so it is 9/16 of the original number of eggs.
questions.questionZh: Smith 先生星期一卖出鸡蛋的 1/4，星期二卖出剩余鸡蛋的 1/4。其余的在星期三卖出。如果他星期三卖出 144 个鸡蛋，他起初有多少个鸡蛋？
questions.hintZh: 星期一后剩下 3/4。星期三的数量是这部分剩余数量的 3/4，因此是原有鸡蛋数量的 9/16。

en.strategy: Express Wednesday's sales as a fraction of the original number of eggs.

steps.title: Find the fraction sold on Wednesday
steps.text: After Monday, 1 − 1/4 = 3/4 of the eggs remained. On Tuesday, 1/4 of that remainder was sold, so 3/4 of the remainder was left for Wednesday. Thus Wednesday's 144 eggs were 3/4 × 3/4 = 9/16 of the original number.

steps.title: Find the original number
steps.text: If 9/16 of the original number is 144, the original number is 144 ÷ 9/16 = 144 × 16/9 = 256 eggs.

en.answerCheck: Mr Smith had 256 eggs in the beginning.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把星期三卖出的鸡蛋数表示为原有鸡蛋数的一个分数。

steps.title: 求星期三所占的分数
steps.text: 星期一后剩下1 − 1/4 = 3/4。星期二卖出这部分的1/4，因此剩下这部分的3/4留到星期三。星期三卖的144个鸡蛋占原有数量的3/4 × 3/4 = 9/16。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 史密斯先生开始时有256个鸡蛋。

questions.question: Sam could buy 4 magazines and 3 books with all his money. He decided to buy 2 magazines and a book. He then had $84 left. If a magazine cost 1/3 the price of a book, how much did Sam have at 1st?
questions.hint: Represent 1 magazine as 1 unit and 1 book as 3 units. The unspent items are 2 magazines and 2 books, worth 8 units and equal to $84.
questions.questionZh: Sam 用所有的钱可以买 4 本杂志和 3 本书。他决定买 2 本杂志和 1 本书，之后还剩 $84。如果 1 本杂志的价格是 1 本书价格的 1/3，Sam 起初（1st）有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 将 1 本杂志表示为 1 个单位，将 1 本书表示为 3 个单位。未购买的物品是 2 本杂志和 2 本书，价值为 8 个单位，等于 $84。

en.strategy: Use a unit model in which one book costs 3 times one magazine, then use the $84 value of the items not bought.

steps.title: Represent the item prices
steps.text: Let a magazine cost 1 unit. Since a magazine costs 1/3 of a book, a book costs 3 units. All of Sam's money could buy 4 magazines and 3 books, worth 4 × 1 + 3 × 3 = 13 units.

steps.title: Find the value of one unit and all his money
steps.text: Sam bought 2 magazines and 1 book, worth 2 × 1 + 1 × 3 = 5 units. The $84 left equals 13 − 5 = 8 units, so 1 unit is $84 ÷ 8 = $10.50. All his money was 13 × $10.50 = $136.50.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把1本书的价格表示成1本杂志的3倍，再利用没有买的物品价值为$84。

steps.title: 表示物品价格
steps.text: 设1本杂志价钱是1个单位。杂志价钱是书的1/3，所以1本书价钱是3个单位。萨姆所有的钱可买4本杂志和3本书，价值4 × 1 + 3 × 3 = 13个单位。

steps.title: 求每单位价值和总钱数

questions.question: A farmer sold some eggs in the morning. He then packed the remaining eggs into 15 cartons with 25 eggs in each carton. If the number of eggs he sold was 3/5 of the number of eggs he packed, how many eggs did the farmer have at 1st?
questions.hint: The packed eggs are 15 × 25. Let the packed eggs be 5 units, so the eggs he sold are 3 units. Find 1 unit, then add both parts.
questions.questionZh: 一位农夫上午卖出了一些鸡蛋。他把剩下的鸡蛋装进15个纸箱，每箱25个。若他卖出的鸡蛋数量是他装箱数量的3/5，农夫开始时有多少个鸡蛋？
questions.hintZh: 装箱的鸡蛋是15 × 25个。把装箱的鸡蛋看作5份，那么卖出的鸡蛋是3份。先求1份，再把两部分相加。

en.strategy: Find the packed eggs, use the 3:5 sold-to-packed relationship, then combine both quantities.

steps.title: Find the eggs packed
steps.text: The farmer packed 15 × 25 = 375 eggs.

steps.title: Find the eggs sold
steps.text: If 375 packed eggs are 5 equal parts, 1 part is 375 ÷ 5 = 75 eggs. The eggs sold were 3 parts: 3 × 75 = 225 eggs.

steps.title: Find the starting total
steps.text: At first he had the eggs sold plus the eggs packed: 225 + 375 = 600 eggs.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求装箱的鸡蛋数，再按卖出数与装箱数的3:5关系求卖出数，最后相加。

steps.title: 求装箱的鸡蛋数
steps.text: 装箱的鸡蛋有15 × 25 = 375个。

steps.title: 求卖出的鸡蛋数
steps.text: 375个装箱鸡蛋是5份，所以1份是375 ÷ 5 = 75个。卖出的鸡蛋是3份，即3 × 75 = 225个。

steps.title: 求原有总数
steps.text: 开始时的鸡蛋数 = 卖出的225个 + 装箱的375个 = 600个。

questions.question: There were some candles in a box. 1/3 of the candles were green. There were 2 times as many blue candles as red candles and 1/4 as many yellow candles as red candles. If there were 24 red candles, how many candles were there in the box altogether?
questions.hint: Find the yellow and blue candles from the 24 red candles. Those 3 colours together are the 2/3 that is not green, so they make 2 units of the whole box.
questions.questionZh: 一个盒子里有一些蜡烛。其中1/3是绿色的。蓝色蜡烛的数量是红色的2倍，黄色蜡烛的数量是红色的1/4。若红色蜡烛有24支，盒子里一共有多少支蜡烛？
questions.hintZh: 由24支红色蜡烛求出黄色和蓝色的数量。这3种颜色合起来就是不含绿色的2/3，也就是整盒的2份。

en.strategy: Calculate the red, blue, and yellow candles first; together they make the non-green 2/3 of the total.

steps.title: Find blue and yellow candles
steps.text: There are 24 red candles. Blue candles = 2 × 24 = 48, and yellow candles = 1/4 × 24 = 6.

steps.title: Find the non-green part
steps.text: Red, blue, and yellow candles total 24 + 48 + 6 = 78. Since green candles are 1/3 of the box, these 78 candles are the other 2/3.

steps.title: Find all candles
steps.text: The total is 78 ÷ 2 × 3 = 117 candles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求红、蓝、黄三种蜡烛的数量；它们合起来占总数中不是绿色的2/3。

steps.title: 求非绿色蜡烛数
steps.text: 红、蓝、黄蜡烛共24 + 48 + 6 = 78支。绿色占1/3，所以这78支占总数的2/3。

answerVisual.sourceMethod: Printed solution uses a three-colour unit model, then a second 3-part whole to add the green third. No discrepancy noted.

questions.question: There were 2 times as many oranges as apples in a box and 3 times as many pears as apples. When 1/4 of the oranges were eaten, there were 21 oranges left in the box. How many pieces of fruit were there in the box at 1st?
questions.hint: Use the 21 remaining oranges to find the original number of oranges, then express apples and pears in terms of apples.
questions.questionZh: 一个盒子里的橙子数量是苹果的2倍，梨的数量是苹果的3倍。吃掉橙子的1/4后，盒子里还剩21个橙子。开始时盒子里共有多少个水果？
questions.hintZh: 由剩下的21个橙子求原来的橙子数，再用苹果表示苹果和梨的数量。

en.strategy: Recover the original oranges from the 21 left, then use the fruit ratios based on apples.

steps.title: Find the original oranges
steps.text: After 1/4 of the oranges were eaten, 3/4 remained. Thus the original number of oranges was 21 ÷ 3 × 4 = 28.

steps.title: Find apples and pears
steps.text: Oranges were twice the apples, so apples = 28 ÷ 2 = 14. Pears were 3 times the apples: 3 × 14 = 42.

steps.title: Add all the fruit
steps.text: The starting total was 28 + 14 + 42 = 84 pieces of fruit.

zh-Hans.strategy: 由剩下的橙子数倒推原来橙子数，再利用以苹果为基准的倍数关系。

steps.title: 求原来橙子数
steps.text: 吃掉1/4后剩下3/4，即21个。因此原来有21 ÷ 3 × 4 = 28个橙子。

steps.title: 求苹果和梨的数量
steps.text: 橙子数是苹果数的2倍，所以苹果有28 ÷ 2 = 14个。梨数是苹果数的3倍，即3 × 14 = 42个。

steps.title: 求水果总数
steps.text: 开始时共有28 + 14 + 42 = 84个水果。

questions.question: Elaine had some sweets. When she ate 2/7 of them and gave 36 sweets to her brother, she had 2/7 of the sweets left. How many sweets did she have at 1st?
questions.hint: Compare the fraction after eating with the fraction finally left. The difference is the 36 sweets given away.
questions.questionZh: 伊莱恩有一些糖。她吃掉其中的2/7，又给弟弟36颗糖后，剩下的糖是原来糖数的2/7。伊莱恩开始时有多少颗糖？
questions.hintZh: 比较吃掉后的分数和最后剩下的分数，两者的差就是送出的36颗糖。

en.strategy: Compare the fraction remaining immediately after eating with the final fraction; the difference was given to her brother.

steps.title: Find the fraction after eating
steps.text: Elaine ate 2/7 of her sweets, so 1 − 2/7 = 5/7 remained.

steps.title: Relate the 36 sweets to the whole
steps.text: She finally had 2/7 left. Therefore the 36 sweets given away were 5/7 − 2/7 = 3/7 of the original number.

steps.title: Find the original number
steps.text: If 3/7 is 36, then 1/7 is 36 ÷ 3 = 12. The original number was 12 × 7 = 84 sweets.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较吃掉后剩下的分数和最后剩下的分数；两者的差就是给弟弟的糖。

steps.title: 把36颗糖对应到原数
steps.text: 最后剩2/7，所以给弟弟的36颗糖占原数的5/7 − 2/7 = 3/7。

questions.question: Mrs Crawford baked some pies. She gave 1/3 of them to her neighbour. She then gave 5/12 of the remainder to a children's home. The rest of the pies were packed into 25 boxes with 14 pies in each box. How many pies did Mrs Crawford bake altogether?
questions.hint: The packed pies are 25 × 14. Work backwards: after giving 1/3 away, 2/3 remains, and then 7/12 of that remainder is packed.
questions.questionZh: 克劳福德太太烤了一些派。她把其中的1/3给了邻居，然后把剩余派的5/12给了一所儿童之家。其余的派装入25个盒子，每盒14个。克劳福德太太一共烤了多少个派？
questions.hintZh: 装盒的派有25 × 14个。倒推：送出1/3后剩下2/3，再送出5/12后，剩余部分的7/12被装盒。

en.strategy: Find the packed pies and express them as the fraction remaining after both gifts.

steps.title: Find the packed pies
steps.text: The 25 boxes hold 25 × 14 = 350 pies.

steps.title: Find the packed fraction of the original
steps.text: After giving 1/3 away, 2/3 remained. Then 5/12 of that remainder was given away, so 7/12 of it was packed. Thus the packed pies were 2/3 × 7/12 = 7/18 of the original.

steps.title: Find the original total
steps.text: If 7/18 is 350, then the total is 350 ÷ 7 × 18 = 900 pies.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求装盒的派数，并把它表示成两次送出后剩下的原数分数。

steps.title: 求装盒部分占原数的分数
steps.text: 送出1/3后剩2/3；再送出剩余部分的5/12后，装盒的是该剩余部分的7/12。因此装盒的派占原数的2/3 × 7/12 = 7/18。

questions.question: Sandy spent 3/5 of her money in a toy shop on a teddy bear for $38 and a toy train for $46. The remaining money was then spent on 5 similar books. How much did each book cost?
questions.hint: The teddy bear and train together represent 3/5 of Sandy's money. Find the remaining 2/5, then share it equally among 5 books.
questions.questionZh: 桑迪在玩具店花掉自己钱的3/5，买了一只$38的泰迪熊和一列$46的玩具火车。剩余的钱买了5本相同的书。每本书多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 泰迪熊和玩具火车的总价代表桑迪钱的3/5。先求剩余的2/5，再平均分给5本书。

en.strategy: The teddy bear and train make up 3/5 of Sandy's money; find the remaining 2/5 and divide it among five books.

steps.title: Find the toy-shop spending
steps.text: The teddy bear and toy train cost $38 + $46 = $84. This is 3/5 of Sandy's money.

steps.title: Find the money left
steps.text: Her total money was $84 ÷ 3 × 5 = $140, so she had $140 − $84 = $56 left.

steps.title: Find one book's cost
steps.text: The $56 bought 5 equal books, so each cost $56 ÷ 5 = $11.20.

zh-Hans.strategy: 泰迪熊和玩具火车的价钱占总钱数的3/5；先求剩下的2/5，再平均分到5本书。

steps.title: 求玩具店花费
steps.text: 泰迪熊和玩具火车共$38 + $46 = $84，这占总钱数的3/5。

questions.question: Jeff sold 120 oranges on Friday. He sold 100 fewer oranges on Friday than on Saturday. The number of oranges he sold on Sunday was 3 times the number he sold on Friday. If he had 2/7 of the oranges left, how many oranges did he have at 1st?
questions.hint: Find sales for Friday, Saturday, and Sunday 1st. These sales make up 5/7 of the original number.
questions.questionZh: 杰夫星期五卖出120个橙子。他星期五比星期六少卖100个橙子。星期日卖出的橙子数量是星期五的3倍。若他还剩原来橙子的2/7，他开始时有多少个橙子？
questions.hintZh: 先求星期五、星期六和星期日各卖出的数量。这些卖出的橙子占原来总数的5/7。

en.strategy: Find the sales on all three days. Those sales are 5/7 of the starting oranges because 2/7 remained.

steps.title: Find each day's sales
steps.text: Friday sales were 120. Saturday sales were 120 + 100 = 220. Sunday sales were 3 × 120 = 360.

steps.title: Find total sales
steps.text: He sold 120 + 220 + 360 = 700 oranges in all. Since 2/7 remained, the 700 sold were 5/7 of the original amount.

steps.title: Find the starting number
steps.text: The original number was 700 ÷ 5 × 7 = 980 oranges.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求三天各卖出的橙子数。因为剩下2/7，所以卖出的数量是原数的5/7。

steps.title: 求卖出的总数
steps.text: 三天共卖120 + 220 + 360 = 700个橙子。剩下2/7，因此卖出的700个是原数的5/7。

questions.question: There were 120 more eggs in box A than in box B. There were 2/3 as many eggs in box C as in box B. When 1/2 of the eggs in box B were sold, there were 222 eggs left in box B. How many eggs were there altogether?
questions.hint: Double the 222 eggs to find box B before any were sold. Use that to calculate boxes A and C.
questions.questionZh: A盒比B盒多120个鸡蛋。C盒的鸡蛋数量是B盒的2/3。当B盒鸡蛋卖出1/2后，B盒剩222个鸡蛋。3个盒子原来一共有多少个鸡蛋？
questions.hintZh: 把222个鸡蛋乘以2，求出卖出前B盒的数量。再利用它计算A盒和C盒。

en.strategy: Double the remaining eggs to find box B before selling, then calculate boxes A and C from B.

steps.title: Find box B originally
steps.text: After half of box B was sold, 222 eggs remained. Therefore box B originally held 222 × 2 = 444 eggs.

steps.title: Find boxes A and C
steps.text: Box A had 444 + 120 = 564 eggs. Box C had 2/3 × 444 = 296 eggs.

steps.title: Find the total
steps.text: The three boxes contained 564 + 444 + 296 = 1304 eggs altogether.

steps.title: 求B盒原有数量
steps.text: 卖出B盒的一半后还剩222个，所以B盒原来有222 × 2 = 444个鸡蛋。

questions.question: Alfred had 72 mugs. He sold some of them for $144. He then had 7/8 of the mugs left. How much would he get if he had sold all the mugs?
questions.hint: Find how many mugs were sold from the 1/8 part. That gives the selling price of 1 mug.
questions.questionZh: 阿尔弗雷德有72个杯子。他卖出一些，得到$144，之后还剩原来杯子的7/8。如果他把所有杯子都卖出，可以得到多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 由1/8求出卖出的杯子数，从而得到1个杯子的售价。

en.strategy: The fraction sold is the part not left. Use it to find how many mugs sold and then the price per mug.

steps.title: Find the mugs sold
steps.text: Since 7/8 were left, 1/8 were sold. Mugs sold = 1/8 × 72 = 9.

steps.title: Find the price per mug
steps.text: Nine mugs brought in $144, so one mug cost $144 ÷ 9 = $16.

steps.title: Find the value of all mugs
steps.text: Selling all 72 mugs would bring 72 × $16 = $1152.

zh-Hans.strategy: 卖出的部分是未剩下的部分。先求卖出多少个杯子，再求每个杯子的售价。

steps.title: 求卖出的杯子数
steps.text: 剩下7/8，说明卖出1/8。卖出杯子数 = 1/8 × 72 = 9个。

steps.title: 求每个杯子的售价
steps.text: 9个杯子卖得$144，所以每个售价为$144 ÷ 9 = $16。

answerVisual.sourceMethod: Printed solution divides all 72 mugs into 8 equal units, marks the one sold unit with $144, and uses that unit to price every mug. No discrepancy noted.

questions.question: There were some chicken wings and fishballs in a pack. After 2/7 of the chicken wings were taken out from the pack, there were 3/10 as many chicken wings as fishballs in the pack. If there were 50 fishballs, how many chicken wings were there in the pack at 1st?
questions.hint: Use 3/10 of 50 to find the wings left after removal. That is 5/7 of the original number of wings.
questions.questionZh: 一包里有一些鸡翅和鱼丸。取出鸡翅的2/7后，包里的鸡翅数量是鱼丸数量的3/10。若有50个鱼丸，开始时包里有多少个鸡翅？
questions.hintZh: 用50的3/10求取出后剩下的鸡翅数。这是原来鸡翅数的5/7。

en.strategy: Use the fishballs to find the wings left after removal, then scale from the remaining 5/7 back to the original number.

steps.title: Find the wings left
steps.text: The remaining chicken wings were 3/10 as many as 50 fishballs: 3/10 × 50 = 15 wings.

steps.title: Relate the remainder to the original
steps.text: After 2/7 were taken out, 1 − 2/7 = 5/7 of the chicken wings remained. Thus 15 wings represent 5/7 of the original number.

steps.title: Find the original wings
steps.text: The original number was 15 ÷ 5 × 7 = 21 chicken wings.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由鱼丸数求取出后剩下的鸡翅数，再由剩下的5/7倒推原有数量。

steps.title: 求剩下的鸡翅数
steps.text: 剩下的鸡翅数是50个鱼丸的3/10，即3/10 × 50 = 15个。

steps.title: 把剩余数对应到原数
steps.text: 取出2/7后还剩1 − 2/7 = 5/7，所以15个鸡翅是原来数量的5/7。

questions.question: There were 1/2 as many yellow T-shirts as blue T-shirts in a box and 15 more green T-shirts than blue T-shirts. There were 27 yellow T-shirts. How many T-shirts were left in the box when 4/5 of the T-shirts were taken out?
questions.hint: Find blue and green T-shirts from the 27 yellow T-shirts. Then take the remaining 1/5 of the total.
questions.questionZh: 一个盒子里黄色T恤的数量是蓝色T恤的1/2，绿色T恤比蓝色T恤多15件。若有27件黄色T恤，取走所有T恤的4/5后，盒子里还剩多少件T恤？
questions.hintZh: 由27件黄色T恤求蓝色和绿色T恤的数量，再求总数的剩余1/5。

en.strategy: Find the blue and green T-shirts from the yellow count, add all colours, then take the remaining 1/5.

steps.title: Find blue and green T-shirts
steps.text: Yellow is half of blue, so blue = 27 × 2 = 54. Green = 54 + 15 = 69.

steps.title: Find the total number
steps.text: The box originally had 27 + 54 + 69 = 150 T-shirts.

steps.title: Find the number left
steps.text: When 4/5 were taken out, 1/5 remained. Thus 1/5 × 150 = 30 T-shirts were left.

zh-Hans.strategy: 由黄色T恤数求蓝色和绿色T恤数，得到总数后取剩下的1/5。

steps.title: 求蓝色和绿色T恤数
steps.text: 黄色是蓝色的1/2，所以蓝色有27 × 2 = 54件。绿色有54 + 15 = 69件。

questions.question: There were some pears in boxes A and B. When 1/3 of the pears were taken out from box A and 5/9 of the pears were taken out from box B, there was an equal number of pears in both boxes. If 84 pears were taken out, how many pears were there in both boxes at 1st?
questions.hint: Draw bars for the original quantities so that their remaining parts are equal. The removed parts total 84.
questions.questionZh: A盒和B盒中有一些梨。从A盒取出梨的1/3，从B盒取出梨的5/9后，两盒的梨数相等。若共取出84个梨，开始时两盒共有多少个梨？
questions.hintZh: 画出原有数量的条形图，使两盒剩余部分相等。取出的部分合计84个。

en.strategy: Represent the equal number left in each box by one common amount, then use the 84 removed pears to find that amount.

steps.title: Express each box using the common remainder
steps.text: Let the equal number left in each box be R pears. Since 2/3 of box A remains, box A originally had 3R/2 and A had R/2 removed. Since 4/9 of box B remains, box B originally had 9R/4 and B had 5R/4 removed.

steps.title: Use the removed pears
steps.text: The removed pears total R/2 + 5R/4 = 7R/4 = 84. Therefore R = 84 × 4 ÷ 7 = 48.

steps.title: Find the starting total
steps.text: Initially, boxes A and B had 3R/2 + 9R/4 = 3 × 48/2 + 9 × 48/4 = 72 + 108 = 180 pears.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把两盒取出后相等的梨数设为同一个量，再利用取出的84个梨求这个量。

steps.title: 用共同的剩余量表示两盒
steps.text: 设两盒各剩R个梨。A盒剩原来的2/3，所以A盒原来有3R/2个，取出了R/2个。B盒剩原来的4/9，所以B盒原来有9R/4个，取出了5R/4个。

questions.question: Agnes had a total of 135 balloons. There were 3 times as many red balloons as green balloons, 2 times as many blue balloons as green balloons and some purple balloons. When 12 green balloons burst, there were 1/3 as many green as purple balloons left. Find the total number of purple and green balloons Agnes had at 1st.
questions.hint: Let green balloons be 1 unit. After 12 burst, use the 1:3 relation between remaining green and purple.
questions.questionZh: 阿格妮丝共有135个气球。红气球数量是绿气球的3倍，蓝气球数量是绿气球的2倍，还有一些紫气球。12个绿气球爆掉后，剩下的绿气球数量是紫气球数量的1/3。求阿格妮丝开始时紫气球和绿气球的总数。
questions.hintZh: 把绿气球设为1份。12个爆掉后，利用剩下绿气球与紫气球的1:3关系。

en.strategy: Let the number of green balloons be a variable. Express red, blue, and purple balloons in terms of it, then use the total.

steps.title: Set up the balloon relationships
steps.text: Let the original number of green balloons be g. Then red balloons = 3g and blue balloons = 2g. After 12 green balloons burst, g − 12 was 1/3 of the purple balloons, so purple balloons = 3(g − 12).

steps.title: Use the total of 135
steps.text: The total gives g + 3g + 2g + 3(g − 12) = 135. Thus 9g − 36 = 135, so 9g = 171 and g = 19.

steps.title: Find green plus purple
steps.text: Purple balloons = 3(19 − 12) = 21. Therefore the original green and purple balloons totaled 19 + 21 = 40.

zh-Hans.strategy: 设原来绿色气球数为未知数，用它表示红、蓝、紫气球数，再利用总数求解。

steps.title: 建立气球数量关系
steps.text: 设原来有g个绿色气球，则红色有3g个，蓝色有2g个。爆掉12个绿色气球后，g − 12是紫色气球数的1/3，所以紫色有3(g − 12)个。

steps.title: 求绿色和紫色气球总数
steps.text: 紫色气球有3(19 − 12) = 21个。因此原来绿色和紫色气球共有19 + 21 = 40个。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：紫色和绿色气球共40个。

questions.question: Michael paid $14 for 3 similar mangoes and a durian. The durian cost $2 more than each mango. What was the total cost of 5 mangoes and 4 durians?
questions.hint: Replace the durian with the cost of a mango plus $2, then find the price of 1 mango.
questions.questionZh: 迈克尔买3个相同的芒果和1个榴莲共付$14。榴莲比每个芒果贵$2。5个芒果和4个榴莲共多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 把榴莲的价格替换为1个芒果的价格加$2，再求1个芒果的价格。

en.strategy: Write the durian price as one mango price plus $2, solve for a mango, then calculate the requested purchase.

steps.title: Find the price of one mango
steps.text: Let one mango cost $m. One durian costs $(m + 2), so 3m + (m + 2) = 14. Hence 4m = 12 and m = 3.

steps.title: Find the durian price
steps.text: A durian costs $3 + $2 = $5.

steps.title: Calculate the new purchase
steps.text: Five mangoes and four durians cost 5 × $3 + 4 × $5 = $15 + $20 = $35.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把榴莲价格表示为一个芒果的价格加$2，先求芒果单价，再计算所求购买总价。

steps.title: 求一个芒果的价格
steps.text: 设一个芒果为$m，一颗榴莲为$(m + 2)。则3m + (m + 2) = 14，所以4m = 12，m = 3。

steps.title: 求榴莲价格
steps.text: 一颗榴莲的价格是$3 + $2 = $5。

questions.question: A blouse costs 1/2 as much as a shirt. If the total cost of 3 similar blouses and a shirt is $200, what is the cost of 7 blouses and 4 shirts?
questions.hint: Use 1 blouse as 1 unit and 1 shirt as 2 units. Convert both purchases into units.
questions.questionZh: 一件女式上衣的价格是一件衬衫的1/2。若3件相同的女式上衣和1件衬衫共$200，7件女式上衣和4件衬衫共多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 把1件女式上衣设为1份，1件衬衫设为2份。把两次购买都换算成份数。

en.strategy: Use one blouse as one unit and one shirt as two units. Determine the value of a unit from the first purchase.

steps.title: Set the unit relationship
steps.text: Let one blouse be 1 unit. Since a blouse costs half as much as a shirt, one shirt is 2 units.

steps.title: Find each unit's value
steps.text: Three blouses and one shirt make 3 × 1 + 2 = 5 units, worth $200. Thus 1 unit is $200 ÷ 5 = $40.

steps.title: Calculate the requested cost
steps.text: Seven blouses and four shirts make 7 × 1 + 4 × 2 = 15 units. Their cost is 15 × $40 = $600.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把一件女式上衣看作1份，一件衬衫看作2份。由第一次购买求每份的价钱。

steps.title: 建立份数关系
steps.text: 设一件女式上衣为1份。女式上衣价格是衬衫的1/2，所以一件衬衫是2份。

questions.question: Colin paid $12 for 4 buns and 4 cakes. 3 buns cost as much as 2 cakes. What was the total cost of 6 buns and 9 cakes?
questions.hint: Represent a bun and cake with equal units using 3 buns = 2 cakes, then use the $12 total.
questions.questionZh: 科林买4个面包和4块蛋糕共付$12。3个面包的价钱等于2块蛋糕的价钱。6个面包和9块蛋糕共多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 利用3个面包 = 2块蛋糕，把面包和蛋糕用相同的份数表示，再利用总价$12。

en.strategy: Use equal price units from 3 buns = 2 cakes, find one unit's value from the $12 purchase, then price the requested items.

steps.title: Set equal cost units
steps.text: Since 3 buns cost as much as 2 cakes, let one bun be 2 units and one cake be 3 units. Then 3 buns and 2 cakes each cost 6 units.

steps.title: Find the value of one unit
steps.text: Four buns and four cakes cost 4 × 2 + 4 × 3 = 20 units, and this is $12. Thus 1 unit costs $12 ÷ 20 = $0.60.

steps.title: Calculate the requested cost
steps.text: Six buns and nine cakes cost 6 × 2 + 9 × 3 = 39 units. Therefore the cost is 39 × $0.60 = $23.40.

zh-Hans.strategy: 由3个面包和2块蛋糕等价设相同的价格份数，利用$12求每份价钱，再计算所求总价。

steps.title: 建立等价份数
steps.text: 3个面包和2块蛋糕同价，可设一个面包为2份、一块蛋糕为3份。这样3个面包和2块蛋糕都是6份。

questions.question: The total cost of a radio, a clock and a blender is $215. The radio costs $35 more than the blender. The blender costs $45 more than the clock. What is the cost of the radio?
questions.hint: Treat the clock as a base amount. Write the blender and radio as that amount plus their stated differences.
questions.questionZh: 一台收音机、一座时钟和一台搅拌机的总价是$215。收音机比搅拌机贵$35，搅拌机比时钟贵$45。收音机多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 把时钟的价格看作基准金额，把搅拌机和收音机写成这个金额加上题中给出的差额。

en.strategy: Use the clock price as the common base amount, then add the stated differences.

steps.title: Express each price from the clock
steps.text: Let the clock cost $x. The blender costs $x + $45, and the radio costs $x + $45 + $35 = $x + $80.

steps.title: Use the total cost
steps.text: Clock + blender + radio gives $x + ($x + $45) + ($x + $80) = $215. Thus 3$x + $125 = $215.

steps.title: Find the radio price
steps.text: 3$x = $215 − $125 = $90, so the clock costs $30. The radio costs $30 + $80 = $110.

en.answerCheck: Clock $30, blender $75, and radio $110 give $30 + $75 + $110 = $215. The radio costs $110.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把时钟的价钱设为基准金额，再加上题目给出的差额。

steps.title: 用时钟价格表示各物品价格
steps.text: 设时钟价格为$x。搅拌机价格为$x + $45，收音机价格为$x + $45 + $35 = $x + $80。

answerVisual.sourceMethod: No canonical/source discrepancy noted. Equal-unit price bars: clock is the base unit; blender adds $45; radio adds a further $35. Remove the added differences from the three-item total, then divide the equal bases and rebuild the radio.

questions.question: Betty had 2 times as much money as Johnson. After Betty spent $350, she had $25 less than Johnson. Find the total amount of money they had at 1st.
questions.hint: After Betty spends $350, compare her amount with Johnson's unchanged amount to find Johnson's money.
questions.questionZh: 贝蒂的钱是约翰逊的2倍。贝蒂花掉$350后，她的钱比约翰逊少$25。求他们开始时的钱总数。
questions.hintZh: 贝蒂花掉$350后，将她的钱与约翰逊未变的钱比较，求出约翰逊的钱。

en.strategy: Compare Betty's original double amount with Johnson's unchanged amount after Betty spends money.

steps.title: Represent their original amounts
steps.text: Let Johnson have $x at 1st. Betty then has 2$x.

steps.title: Use the amount after spending
steps.text: After spending $350, Betty has 2$x − $350. This is $25 less than Johnson's $x, so 2$x − $350 = $x − $25.

steps.title: Find the total
steps.text: Subtract $x from both sides: $x = $325. Betty had 2 × $325 = $650, so together they had $325 + $650 = $975.

en.answerCheck: After Betty spends $350, she has $650 − $350 = $300, which is $25 less than Johnson's $325. Their original total was $975.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较贝蒂原来是2倍的钱数与约翰逊不变的钱数，并利用贝蒂花钱后的关系。

steps.title: 表示开始时的钱数
steps.text: 设约翰逊开始时有$x，贝蒂开始时就有2$x。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 贝蒂花钱后有$650 − $350 = $300，正好比约翰逊的$325少$25。开始时两人共有$975。

answerVisual.sourceMethod: No canonical/source discrepancy noted. A before-and-after comparison bar shows Betty initially at two Johnson units; her $350 spending leaves her $25 below Johnson, so the gap between one unit and the post-spending comparison fixes Johnson's unit.

questions.question: Connie and Alice had an equal amount of money at 1st. Connie gave Alice $126 and Alice had 4 times as much money as Connie in the end. How much money did Connie have at 1st?
questions.hint: The $126 transfer creates a difference between the final amounts. Model the final 4:1 ratio.
questions.questionZh: 康妮和爱丽丝开始时的钱一样多。康妮给爱丽丝$126后，最后爱丽丝的钱是康妮的4倍。康妮开始时有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 转移$126使最后金额产生差距。把最后的金额按4:1比例表示。

en.strategy: Use the $126 transfer to express the final amounts, then apply the final 4:1 ratio.

steps.title: Represent the equal starting amounts
steps.text: Let each girl have $x at 1st. After Connie gives Alice $126, Connie has $x − $126 and Alice has $x + $126.

steps.title: Apply the final ratio
steps.text: Alice has 4 times Connie's amount, so $x + $126 = 4($x − $126).

steps.title: Solve for Connie's starting money
steps.text: Expand: $x + $126 = 4$x − $504. Therefore $630 = 3$x and $x = $210.

en.answerCheck: Connie ends with $210 − $126 = $84 and Alice ends with $210 + $126 = $336. Since $336 = 4 × $84, Connie had $210 at 1st.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把$126的转移写入两人最后的钱数，再使用最后4:1的比例。

steps.title: 表示相同的开始金额
steps.text: 设两人开始时各有$x。康妮给爱丽丝$126后，康妮有$x − $126，爱丽丝有$x + $126。

steps.title: 利用最后的比例
steps.text: 爱丽丝的钱是康妮的4倍，所以$x + $126 = 4($x − $126)。

questions.question: Terence and Winnie had a total of 27 coins. When Terence gave Winnie 1/4 of his coins, she had 2 times as many coins as him. Winnie then found out that she had 2 times as many 20-cent coins as 10-cent coins. How much money did she have in the end?
questions.hint: 1st find Winnie's final number of coins using the transfer and total of 27. Then split them in the 2:1 ratio of 20-cent to 10-cent coins.
questions.questionZh: 特伦斯和温妮共有27枚硬币。特伦斯把自己硬币的1/4给温妮后，她的硬币数量是他的2倍。温妮随后发现，她的20分硬币数量是10分硬币的2倍。她最后有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 先利用转移和总数27求温妮最后的硬币数，再按20分硬币与10分硬币2:1的比例分配。

en.strategy: Find Winnie's final number of coins from the 2:1 coin-number ratio, then split her coins by denomination.

steps.title: Find the final coin numbers
steps.text: The total remains 27 coins. After the transfer, Winnie has twice as many coins as Terence, so their final numbers are in the ratio 2:1. Each part is 27 ÷ 3 = 9 coins; Winnie has 2 × 9 = 18 coins.

steps.title: Split Winnie's coins by type
steps.text: Winnie's 20-cent coins and 10-cent coins are in the ratio 2:1. Split 18 coins into 3 parts: 1 part is 18 ÷ 3 = 6 coins. She has 12 twenty-cent coins and 6 ten-cent coins.

steps.title: Find the value
steps.text: The 12 twenty-cent coins are worth 12 × $0.20 = $2.40. The 6 ten-cent coins are worth 6 × $0.10 = $0.60.

en.answerCheck: $2.40 + $0.60 = $3, so Winnie had $3 in the end.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由最后2:1的硬币数量关系求温妮的硬币总数，再按币值种类的2:1比例分配。

steps.title: 求最后各自的硬币数
steps.text: 硬币总数仍是27枚。转移后温妮的硬币数是特伦斯的2倍，比例为2:1。每份是27 ÷ 3 = 9枚，所以温妮有2 × 9 = 18枚。

steps.title: 按币值分配温妮的硬币
steps.text: 温妮的20分硬币与10分硬币数量比为2:1。18枚分成3份，每份是18 ÷ 3 = 6枚，因此有12枚20分硬币和6枚10分硬币。

questions.question: Hazel had enough money to buy 25 chocolate cookies. Each chocolate cookie cost as much as 2 butter cookies. Hazel borrowed another $6 from her mother to buy 20 chocolate cookies and 20 butter cookies. How much money did Hazel have at 1st?
questions.hint: Convert 20 butter cookies into an equivalent number of chocolate cookies and compare the 2 purchases.
questions.questionZh: 黑兹尔的钱刚好可以买25块巧克力饼干。每块巧克力饼干的价钱等于2块黄油饼干的价钱。她向母亲借了$6后，买20块巧克力饼干和20块黄油饼干。黑兹尔开始时有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 每1块巧克力饼干相当于2块黄油饼干。把20块黄油饼干换算成等价数量的巧克力饼干，比较2次购买。

en.strategy: Measure both purchases in chocolate-cookie price units.

steps.title: Convert butter cookies
steps.text: One chocolate cookie costs as much as 2 butter cookies. Therefore, 20 butter cookies cost the same as 20 ÷ 2 = 10 chocolate cookies.

steps.title: Compare the two amounts of money
steps.text: The later purchase of 20 chocolate cookies and 20 butter cookies costs the same as 20 + 10 = 30 chocolate cookies. Hazel originally had the cost of 25 chocolate cookies, so the difference is the cost of 5 chocolate cookies.

steps.title: Find Hazel's original money
steps.text: The extra 5 chocolate-cookie prices equal the $6 borrowed. Thus one chocolate cookie costs $6 ÷ 5 = $1.20, and 25 cost 25 × $1.20 = $30.

en.answerCheck: 25 chocolate cookies cost $30. Adding the $6 borrowed gives $36, which pays for 30 chocolate-cookie price units at $1.20 each. Hazel had $30 at 1st.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把两次购买都换算成巧克力饼干的价钱单位。

steps.title: 换算黄油饼干
steps.text: 1块巧克力饼干和2块黄油饼干价钱相同，所以20块黄油饼干相当于20 ÷ 2 = 10块巧克力饼干的价钱。

steps.title: 比较两次可购买的数量
steps.text: 后一次买20块巧克力饼干和20块黄油饼干，相当于20 + 10 = 30块巧克力饼干的价钱。开始时的钱能买25块，两者相差5块巧克力饼干的价钱。

steps.title: 求开始时的钱数
steps.text: 多出的5块巧克力饼干价钱就是借来的$6，所以每块巧克力饼干是$6 ÷ 5 = $1.20。开始时的钱是25 × $1.20 = $30。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 25块巧克力饼干值$30。加上借来的$6共有$36，正好能买30个每个$1.20的巧克力饼干价钱单位。因此开始时有$30。

questions.question: A book costs 3 times as much as a pen. 5 similar pens cost as much as a photo frame. If 3 similar photo frames cost $74.25, what is the total cost of a book, a pen and a photo frame?
questions.hint: Express a pen, book, and photo frame in 1 common unit before using the cost of 3 photo frames.
questions.questionZh: 一本书的价格是一支笔的3倍。5支相同的笔的价格等于一个相框。若3个相同的相框共$74.25，一本书、一支笔和一个相框的总价是多少？
questions.hintZh: 先把一支笔、一本书和一个相框都用1个共同单位表示，再利用3个相框的价钱。

en.strategy: Find the photo-frame price first, then use its links to the pen and book prices.

steps.title: Find one photo frame
steps.text: 3 similar photo frames cost $74.25, so 1 photo frame costs $74.25 ÷ 3 = $24.75.

steps.title: Find the pen and book prices
steps.text: 5 pens cost as much as 1 photo frame, so a pen costs $24.75 ÷ 5 = $4.95. A book costs 3 times a pen, so it costs 3 × $4.95 = $14.85.

steps.title: Add the three items
steps.text: Book + pen + photo frame costs $14.85 + $4.95 + $24.75.

questions.question: For every T-shirt that Joel sells, he will receive $12. He will receive another $5 for every set of 10 T-shirts he sells. If he sells 100 T-shirts, he will receive an additional $50 bonus. How many T-shirts does Joel have to sell to receive $1372 in total?
questions.hint: 1st calculate Joel's earnings for 100 T-shirts, including the 10 set bonuses and the $50 bonus.
questions.questionZh: 乔尔每卖出1件T恤可得$12。每卖出10件T恤，他还可额外得到$5。若卖出100件T恤，他可额外得到$50奖金。乔尔要卖出多少件T恤才能共得到$1372？
questions.hintZh: 先计算乔尔卖出100件T恤的收入，包括10次每组奖金和$50奖金。

en.strategy: Calculate the guaranteed earnings at 100 T-shirts, then add the earnings from further T-shirts.

steps.title: Find earnings for 100 T-shirts
steps.text: The per-shirt pay is 100 × $12 = $1200. There are 100 ÷ 10 = 10 set bonuses, worth 10 × $5 = $50, plus the $50 bonus for selling 100 T-shirts.

steps.title: Compare with the target
steps.text: For 100 T-shirts, Joel earns $1200 + $50 + $50 = $1300. He needs $1372 − $1300 = $72 more.

steps.title: Find the additional T-shirts
steps.text: After 100, each additional T-shirt earns $12 until another full set of 10 is reached. $72 ÷ $12 = 6, so Joel needs 100 + 6 = 106 T-shirts.

en.answerCheck: For 106 T-shirts, Joel earns 106 × $12 + 10 × $5 + $50 = $1272 + $50 + $50 = $1372. He must sell 106 T-shirts.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先计算卖出100件T恤时的固定收入，再补上达到目标所需的额外收入。

steps.title: 求额外需要卖出的件数
steps.text: 卖出100件以后，尚未凑满下一组10件时，每多卖1件可得$12。$72 ÷ $12 = 6，所以要卖100 + 6 = 106件。

answerVisual.sourceMethod: No canonical/source discrepancy noted. A three-row earnings table calculates the pay for 1, 10, and 100 T-shirts, including both bonuses at 100; compare that subtotal to the target and convert the remaining $72 at $12 per shirt.

questions.question: 4 boxes of coloured pencils cost as much as 3 boxes of paint. Natalie had just enough money to buy 7 boxes of paint and 2 boxes of coloured pencils. If a box of paint cost $5.40, how much would Natalie have left if she only bought 5 boxes of paint?
questions.hint: Use 3 paint boxes = 4 coloured-pencil boxes to price 2 coloured-pencil boxes, then find Natalie's original money.
questions.questionZh: 4盒彩色铅笔的价钱等于3盒颜料。娜塔莉的钱刚好可以买7盒颜料和2盒彩色铅笔。若每盒颜料$5.40，她只买5盒颜料会剩下多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 利用3盒颜料 = 4盒彩色铅笔，求2盒彩色铅笔的价钱，再求娜塔莉原有的钱。

en.strategy: Use the price relationship between paint and coloured-pencil boxes to find Natalie's original money.

steps.title: Find the coloured-pencil-box price
steps.text: 3 boxes of paint cost 3 × $5.40 = $16.20, the same as 4 boxes of coloured pencils. Thus 2 coloured-pencil boxes cost half of $16.20, or $8.10.

steps.title: Find Natalie's original money
steps.text: 7 paint boxes cost 7 × $5.40 = $37.80. Together with 2 coloured-pencil boxes, Natalie had $37.80 + $8.10 = $45.90.

steps.title: Subtract the cost of 5 paint boxes
steps.text: 5 paint boxes cost 5 × $5.40 = $27.00. Subtract this from $45.90.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用颜料盒与彩色铅笔盒的价钱关系，先求娜塔莉原有的钱数。

steps.title: 求彩色铅笔盒的价钱
steps.text: 3盒颜料值3 × $5.40 = $16.20，等于4盒彩色铅笔的价钱。因此2盒彩色铅笔值$16.20的一半，即$8.10。

answerVisual.sourceMethod: No canonical/source discrepancy noted. A four-to-three equal-unit price bar equates four coloured-pencil boxes with three $5.40 paint boxes. Halve that shared value for two pencil boxes, build Natalie's initial money, then subtract five paint boxes.

questions.question: Jeffrey had 4 times as many 20-cent coins as 10-cent coins and 1/3 as many 50-cent coins as 10-cent coins. If he had 2 of the 50-cent coins, how much money would he have left if he spent $2.75 on a pair of socks?
questions.hint: The 50-cent coins are 1/3 of the 10-cent coins, so use the 2 of them to find how many 10-cent coins there are. Then find the number and the total value of all the coins.
questions.questionZh: 杰弗里20分硬币的数量是10分硬币的4倍，50分硬币的数量是10分硬币的1/3。若他有2枚50分硬币，买一双袜子花$2.75后还剩多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 50分硬币的数量是10分硬币的1/3，所以用这2枚求出10分硬币有多少枚。再求所有硬币的数量和总价值。

en.strategy: Use the 50-cent coins to determine each coin count, then calculate the total value.

steps.title: Find the numbers of coins
steps.text: The 2 fifty-cent coins are 1/3 as many as the ten-cent coins, so there are 2 × 3 = 6 ten-cent coins. There are 4 times as many twenty-cent coins, or 4 × 6 = 24.

steps.title: Find the value before buying socks
steps.text: The ten-cent coins are worth 6 × $0.10 = $0.60, the twenty-cent coins are worth 24 × $0.20 = $4.80, and the fifty-cent coins are worth 2 × $0.50 = $1.00. Total value is $6.40.

steps.title: Subtract the sock cost
steps.text: Subtract the $2.75 spent on socks from the $6.40 in coins.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由50分硬币数求各种硬币的数量，再计算所有硬币的总值。

steps.title: 求各种硬币的枚数
steps.text: 2枚50分硬币是10分硬币数量的1/3，所以10分硬币有2 × 3 = 6枚。20分硬币是10分硬币的4倍，即4 × 6 = 24枚。

steps.title: 减去袜子的价钱
steps.text: 用硬币总值$6.40减去买袜子的$2.75。

answerVisual.sourceMethod: No canonical/source discrepancy noted. A multiplicity bar uses the two 50-cent coins as one third of the 10-cent count and shows the 20-cent count as four times the 10-cent count. It then totals denomination values before subtracting the socks cost.

questions.question: Michael had some flowers. He sold 2/3 of them at 90¢ each and the rest at 50¢ each. Fanny sold the same number of flowers at 80¢ each, collecting a total of $7.20. How much did Michael collect?
questions.hint: Use Fanny's $7.20 at 80¢ each to find the number of flowers. Then split Michael's flowers into 2/3 and 1/3.
questions.questionZh: 迈克尔有一些花。他以每朵90¢卖出其中的2/3，以每朵50¢卖出其余的花。范妮以每朵80¢卖出同样数量的花，共收$7.20。迈克尔共收多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 由范妮每朵80¢、共$7.20求花的数量。再把迈克尔的花按2/3和1/3分开。

en.strategy: Use Fanny's sales to find the common number of flowers, then split Michael's flowers into 2/3 and 1/3.

steps.title: Find the number of flowers
steps.text: Fanny collected $7.20 at $0.80 per flower, so she sold $7.20 ÷ $0.80 = 9 flowers. Michael had the same number, 9 flowers.

steps.title: Find Michael's sales at each price
steps.text: Michael sold 2/3 of 9, or 6 flowers, at $0.90 each. He sold the remaining 1/3 of 9, or 3 flowers, at $0.50 each.

steps.title: Add Michael's collections
steps.text: The two collections are 6 × $0.90 = $5.40 and 3 × $0.50 = $1.50.

zh-Hans.strategy: 由范妮的销售额求出共同的花朵数量，再把迈克尔的花分成2/3和1/3。

steps.title: 求花朵数
steps.text: 范妮每朵卖$0.80，共收$7.20，所以她卖出$7.20 ÷ $0.80 = 9朵。迈克尔也有同样的9朵花。

steps.title: 求迈克尔按两种价钱卖出的数量
steps.text: 迈克尔以每朵$0.90卖出9的2/3，即6朵；以每朵$0.50卖出剩下的1/3，即3朵。

answerVisual.sourceMethod: No canonical/source discrepancy noted. The printed arithmetic first converts Fanny's collection at 80¢ each into a shared flower count, then splits Michael's flowers into 2/3 at 90¢ and the remainder at 50¢ before adding the two collections.
